text_es: Planning a train trip is not as complex as it seems and offers a unique experience. It is essential, first of all, to decide on the destination and dates so you can look for tickets in advance, which usually guarantees optimal prices. One should not underestimate the importance of schedule flexibility, as some connections are limited. It is always a good idea to check the different types of seats and services on board; not all trains have the same amenities. It is necessary to determine if it is essential to reserve a seat in advance—a crucial action on popular routes. Furthermore, you can bring your own food and drink on many trips, which represents effective savings. Finally, you are one click away from an adventure on rails, an activity that is currently gaining more followers.
text_tgt_raw: Planear uma viagem de comboio não é tão complexo como parece e oferece uma experiência única. É fundamental, em primeiro lugar, decidir o destino e as datas para poder procurar bilhetes com antecedência, o que geralmente garante preços ótimos. Não se deve subestimar a importância da flexibilidade de horários, pois algumas conexões são limitadas. É sempre uma boa ideia verificar os diferentes tipos de lugares e serviços a bordo; nem todos os comboios têm as mesmas comodidades. É preciso detetar se é necessário reservar um lugar antecipadamente — uma ação crucial em rotas populares. Além disso, pode levar a sua própria comida e bebida em muitas viagens, o que representa uma economia efetiva. Finalmente, está a um clique de uma aventura sobre carris, uma atividade que, atualmente, ganha mais adeptos.
base_en: Planning a train trip isn't as complex as it seems and offers a different experience. It's essential to 1st decide on the destination and dates to be able to look for tickets in advance, as this usually guarantees better prices. One shouldn't underestimate the importance of schedule flexibility, as some connections are limited. It's always a good idea to check the different types of seats and services on board; not all trains have the same amenities. Don't forget to verify if you need to reserve a seat in advance—that's crucial on popular routes. Furthermore, you're free to bring your own food and drink on many journeys, which saves you some money. Finally, you're a click away from an adventure on rails.

text_es: Planning a train trip is a simple task if you follow a few essential steps. The first step, in fact, is to define your destination and desired dates, as postponing this decision can result in much less optimal prices. It is crucial to research routes and schedules on the respective railway companies' websites, as there isn't a single platform for all European trains, requiring some direct investigation. If you intend to take several trips, adopting a train pass can be an excellent action to optimize costs. Don't forget to reserve seats, especially on high-speed trains or during peak seasons, avoiding the surprise of not finding available seats at the last minute. In my opinion, I always like to arrive at the station well in advance, because you never know what unforeseen event might arise.
text_tgt_raw: Planear uma viagem de comboio é uma tarefa simples se seguir algumas etapas essenciais. O primeiro passo, de fato, é definir o seu destino e as datas pretendidas, pois adiar esta decisão pode resultar em preços muito menos ótimos. É crucial pesquisar as rotas e horários nos sites das respetivas empresas ferroviárias, já que não existe uma plataforma única para todos os comboios europeus, exigindo alguma investigação direta. Se tenciona realizar várias viagens, a adoção de um passe de comboio pode ser uma excelente ação para otimizar custos. Não se esqueça de reservar os lugares, principalmente em comboios de alta velocidade ou em épocas de maior atividade, evitando a surpresa de não encontrar assentos disponíveis à última hora. Pela minha direção, gosto sempre de chegar à estação com bastante antecedência, pois nunca se sabe que imprevisto pode surgir.
base_en: To plan a train trip, it isn't difficult if you follow a few key steps. The 1st thing you have to do is decide your destination and dates; it isn't good to leave it until the last minute, as prices can rise considerably. Look for routes and schedules on the railway companies' websites; there isn't a single website for all European trains, so it's better to do a little research. Consider buying a train pass if you're going to make several trips, that's very useful and saves you money. Don't forget to reserve seats either, especially on high-speed trains or if you're traveling in high season, because the train doesn't have to have free seats at the last minute. I'm one of those who always arrive at the station early—you never know what unforeseen event might arise!

text_es: Making bread at home is a rewarding activity that isn't limited to experts. It's not restricted to a single recipe; there's a vast selection of breads you can try, from classic white bread to more complex sourdough options. It's not difficult to start; you just need flour, water, yeast, and salt, although you can add other ingredients. The process involves mixing the ingredients, kneading the dough – which doesn't have to be exhausting – letting it rise, and then baking it. Watching the dough rise and the aroma that fills the kitchen while it bakes is a great experience. Furthermore, homemade bread has no preservatives and its flavor is incomparable to store-bought, a factor that makes it a superior option. The satisfaction of eating fresh bread, made with your own hands, is an achievable goal that's worth the effort.
text_tgt_raw: Fazer pão em casa é uma atividade gratificante que não se limita apenas a especialistas. Não está restrito a uma única receita; há uma vasta seleção de pães que pode experimentar, desde o clássico pão branco até opções mais complexas de massa lêveda. Não é difícil começar; precisa apenas de farinha, água, fermento e sal, embora possa adicionar outros ingredientes. O processo envolve misturar os ingredientes, amassar a massa – o que não tem de ser exaustivo – deixá-la levedar e, depois, levá-la ao forno. Observar a massa a crescer e o aroma que inunda a cozinha enquanto coze é uma ótima experiência. Além disso, o pão caseiro não tem conservantes e o seu sabor é incomparável ao comprado, um fator que o torna uma opção superior. A satisfação de comer um pão fresco, feito pelas suas próprias mãos, é um objetivo alcançável que vale o esforço.
base_en: Making bread at home is a rewarding activity that isn't just for experts. You aren't limited to a single recipe; there's a wide variety of breads you can try, from classic white bread to more complex sourdough options. It isn't difficult to start; you just need flour, water, yeast, and salt, although that isn't all you can add. The process involves mixing the ingredients, kneading the dough—which doesn't have to be exhausting—letting it rise, and then baking it. Watching the dough grow and the aroma that fills the kitchen while it bakes, that's a wonderful experience. Furthermore, homemade bread doesn't have preservatives and its flavor is incomparable to store-bought; you won't regret trying it.

text_es: If you want to start in the world of home baking, don't worry at first; it's not as complicated as it seems. The first action to take is to look for a basic recipe for white or whole wheat bread; it doesn't need to be sourdough if you don't feel confident yet. A crucial factor is patience and practice, which are your best allies – there are no shortcuts to great bread. Make sure you have the essential ingredients (flour, water, yeast, salt) and a reliable scale; precision is an important goal. Don't forget that room temperature has a direct impact on dough growth. I'm sure that with two or three attempts, you'll start to get the hang of it and be surprised by the reward of baking your own bread, a very gratifying activity.
text_tgt_raw: Se pretende iniciar-se no mundo da panificação caseira, não se preocupe inicialmente; não é tão complicado como parece. A primeira ação a tomar é procurar uma receita básica para pão branco ou integral, não precisa de ser de massa mãe se ainda não se sentir confiante. Um fator crucial é a paciência e a prática, que são os seus melhores aliados – não há atalhos para um pão ótimo. Assegure-se de que tem os ingredientes essenciais (farinha, água, levedura, sal) e uma balança fiável; a precisão é um objetivo importante. Não se esqueça de que a temperatura ambiente tem um impacto direto no crescimento da massa. Tenho a certeza de que, com duas ou três tentativas, começará a apanhar-lhe o jeito e ficará surpreendido com a recompensa de cozer o seu próprio pão, uma atividade bastante gratificante.
base_en: If you want to get started in the world of making bread at home, don't stress at 1st; it isn't as complicated as it seems. The 1st thing is to look for a basic recipe for white or whole wheat bread, it doesn't have to be sourdough if you don't feel confident yet. This is key: patience and practice are your best allies, there are no shortcuts to good bread. Make sure you've the essential ingredients—flour, water, yeast, salt—and a reliable scale; precision is important. Don't forget that room temperature greatly influences the rising. I'm sure that with 2 or 3 tries, you'll start to get the hang of it and you'll be surprised how rewarding it's to bake your own bread.

text_es: Adopting a dog isn't just bringing an animal home; it's a serious action and a decision that will change your life and theirs. Before taking this step, it's essential to consider several factors: do you have time to walk and care for it? Is your home suitable for a dog? There's no rush, think carefully about the breed and size that best fit your lifestyle, because a large dog is not the same as a small one. Many shelters have animals that need a home and ask for nothing in return, just love and affection. That's the most important thing, really. You are about to give a living being a second chance, and the unconditional love you receive in return is of great value. Furthermore, by adopting, you not only save a life but also free up space for another animal in need, in a way that benefits the current animal welfare community, which is an act of great compassion.
text_tgt_raw: Adotar um cão não é apenas trazer um animal para casa; é uma ação séria e uma decisão que irá mudar a sua vida e a deles. Antes de dar este passo, é fundamental considerar vários fatores: tem tempo para passear e cuidar dele? A sua casa é adequada para um cão? Não há pressa, pense cuidadosamente na raça e no tamanho que melhor se adaptam ao seu estilo de vida, pois um cão grande não é o mesmo que um pequeno. Muitos abrigos têm animais que precisam de um lar e não pedem nada em troca, apenas amor e carinho. Essa é a coisa mais importante, realmente. Está prestes a dar uma segunda oportunidade a um ser vivo, e o amor incondicional que recebe em troca é de um valor ótimo. Além disso, ao adotar, não só salva uma vida, mas também liberta espaço para outro animal necessitado, numa direção que beneficia a atual comunidade de proteção animal, o que é um ato de grande compaixão.
base_en: Adopting a dog isn't just bringing an animal home; it's a serious commitment and a decision that will change your life and theirs. Before taking the step, it's essential to consider several factors: do you've time to walk and care for it? Is your home suitable for a dog? There's no rush, think carefully about the breed and size that best suits your lifestyle, because a large dog isn't the same as a small one. Many shelters have animals that need a home and ask for nothing in return, only love and care. That's the most important thing, really. You're about to give a 2nd chance to a living being, and the unconditional love you receive in return is priceless. Furthermore, by adopting, you not only save a life, but you also free up space for another animal in need.

text_es: Before adopting a dog, it's essential to be well-informed; it's not a decision to be taken lightly. Think about the time you will dedicate to it, because a dog is not just companionship, it needs walks, playtime, and daily attention. Are you willing to do that? Also consider your economic situation; you shouldn't underestimate the costs of food, vet, and accessories, which are not exactly low. If you live in an apartment, don't forget that certain breeds need more space than others; this is an important factor. Look for a shelter or a rescue association; not only will you find the perfect companion for you, but you will also help an animal in need. That way, you don't just adopt a pet, but you save a life, and that's what really matters, an act of great significance.
text_tgt_raw: Antes de adotar um cão, é fundamental estar bem-informado; não é uma decisão que se deva tomar de ânimo leve. Pense no tempo que lhe vai dedicar, pois um cão não é apenas companhia, precisa de passeios, brincadeiras e atenção diária. Está disposto a essa ação? Considere também a sua situação económica; não deve subestimar os custos de alimentação, veterinário e acessórios, que não são exatamente baixos. Se vive num apartamento, não se esqueça que certas raças precisam de mais espaço do que outras; este é um fator importante. Procure um abrigo ou uma associação de resgate; não só encontrará o companheiro ótimo para si, como também ajudará um animal necessitado. Dessa forma, não adota apenas um animal de estimação, mas salva uma vida, e é isso que realmente importa, um ato de grande significado.
base_en: Before adopting a dog, it's essential to be well-informed; it's not a decision that should be taken lightly. Think about the time you're going to dedicate to it, because a dog isn't just companionship, it needs walks, games, and daily attention. Are you willing to do that? Also consider your economic situation; you shouldn't underestimate the costs of food, vet, and accessories, they aren't exactly low. If you live in an apartment, don't forget that certain breeds need more space than others; it's not a minor factor. Look for a shelter or rescue; not only will you find the perfect companion, but you'll also help an animal in need. That way, you don't just adopt a pet, but you save a life, and that's what really matters.

text_es: Yesterday, I embarked on the adventure of assembling a shelf I bought, and it was anything but easy. The box indicated 1 hour for assembly, but of course, that's neither current nor realistic for someone without experience. I don't have much dexterity with screwdrivers, and that was evident. The instructions, to make matters worse, weren't very clear, a true hieroglyph that offered no useful direction. I think about 3 hours passed before the structure started to take shape, which wasn't a great start! The final result, to be honest, isn't bad at all, although a couple of shelves aren't perfectly level. I definitely don't want to repeat this activity anytime soon.
text_tgt_raw: Ontem, embarquei na aventura de montar uma prateleira que comprei, e não foi nada fácil. A caixa indicava 1 hora para a montagem, mas claro, isso não é atual nem real para alguém sem experiência. Não tenho muita destreza com chaves de fenda, e isso foi notório. As instruções, para piorar, não eram muito claras, um verdadeiro hieróglifo que não oferecia uma direção útil. Penso que cerca de 3 horas se passaram antes de a estrutura começar a tomar forma, o que não foi um ótimo começo! O resultado final, para ser honesto, não é mau de todo, embora um par de prateleiras não esteja perfeitamente nivelado. Definitivamente, não quero repetir esta atividade tão cedo.
base_en: Yesterday I embarked on the adventure of assembling a shelf I bought, and it wasn't easy at all. The box indicated 1 hour for assembly, but of course, that's not possible for someone without experience. I don't have much skill with screwdrivers, and that was noticeable. The instructions, moreover, weren't very clear, a real hieroglyph that wasn't very helpful. I think about 3 hours passed before the structure started to take shape, no joke! The final result, to be honest, isn't bad at all, although a couple of shelves aren't perfectly level. I definitely don't want to repeat the experience soon.

text_es: Assembling a shelf, despite seeming like a simple act, isn't as easy as many think—I swear! Before you start, make sure you have all the parts and tools listed in the manual; there's nothing more frustrating than realizing you're missing a screw halfway through the process. I recommend thoroughly cleaning your work area to avoid any unwanted reactions or tripping hazards. Read the instructions twice before tightening the first screw; this is a crucial step to prevent mistakes. Sometimes, the assembly direction isn't obvious. If the shelf is large, don't hesitate to ask for help; you don't have to do it alone, and it's not a competition. In the end, check for stability; we don't want the contents to fall at the first oversight. It's great to be sure of a job well done.
text_tgt_raw: Montar uma prateleira, apesar de parecer um ato simples, não é tão fácil como muitos pensam — juro! Antes de começar, certifique-se de que tem todas as peças e ferramentas indicadas no manual; não há nada mais frustrante do que detetar que lhe falta um parafuso a meio do processo. Recomendo que limpe bem a área de trabalho para evitar qualquer reação indesejada ou tropeções. Leia as instruções duas vezes antes de apertar o primeiro parafuso; esta é uma ação crucial para evitar erros. Por vezes, a direção da montagem não é óbvia. Se a prateleira for grande, não hesite em pedir ajuda; não tem de fazer isso sozinho, e não é uma competição. No final, verifique a estabilidade; não queremos que o conteúdo caia ao primeiro descuido. É ótimo ter a certeza de um trabalho bem feito.
base_en: Assembling a shelf, although it seems simple, isn't as easy as many people think—no joke! Before starting, make sure you've all the parts and tools indicated in the manual; there's nothing more frustrating than realizing you're missing a screw halfway through the process. I recommend clearing the work area well, so you aren't tripping over other things. Read the instructions 2 full times before tightening the 1st screw; this is crucial to avoid mistakes. Sometimes the assembly order isn't obvious. If the shelf is large, don't hesitate to ask for help; you don't have to do it alone, and this isn't a competition. When finished, check the stability; you don't want all the contents to fall at the 1st oversight.

text_es: Saving for vacation is currently a fundamental act to enjoy a well-deserved rest without financial worries, being much more than a simple matter of money. Advance planning is the key factor; that is, establishing a detailed budget for transportation, accommodation, meals, and activities, so there are no surprises. It's not too much to consider an emergency fund for unforeseen events. A great strategy is to allocate a fixed amount every month to a specific savings account; this action proves to be very effective. Furthermore, you can look for offers and discounts in advance, as they are often not available at the last minute. Reducing superfluous daily expenses—like coffees or eating out—can generate considerable savings, and this doesn't mean giving up everything. You are planning an unforgettable future trip.
text_tgt_raw: Poupar para as férias é, atualmente, um ato fundamental para desfrutar de um merecido descanso sem preocupações financeiras, sendo muito mais do que uma simples questão de dinheiro. O planeamento antecipado é o fator chave; isto é, estabelecer um orçamento detalhado para transportes, alojamento, refeições e atividades, para que não haja surpresas. Não é demais considerar um fundo de emergência para eventos imprevistos. Uma ótima estratégia é alocar um montante fixo todos os meses para uma conta poupança específica; esta ação revela-se muito eficaz. Além disso, pode procurar ofertas e descontos com antecedência, pois muitas vezes não estão disponíveis à última hora. Reduzir despesas diárias supérfluas — como cafés ou refeições fora — pode gerar uma poupança considerável, e isto não significa abdicar de tudo. Está a projetar uma viagem futura inesquecível.
base_en: Saving for vacation is essential to enjoy a well-deserved rest without financial worries; it isn't just a matter of money. Planning ahead is key; that's, establishing a detailed budget for transportation, accommodation, meals, and activities, so there are no surprises. It doesn't hurt to consider an emergency fund for unforeseen events. A good strategy is to allocate a fixed amount each month to a specific savings account; that's a habit that works very well. In addition, you can look for offers and discounts in advance, as they often aren't available at the last minute. Reducing superfluous daily expenses—like coffees or meals out—can generate considerable savings, and this doesn't mean giving up everything. You're building an unforgettable future trip.

text_es: I've been saving for 6 months for my next vacation, and honestly, it's not an easy task. Every month I aim to save a fixed amount, but an unexpected expense always comes up and I can't stick to the plan. The problem is that I love to travel and my budget isn't unlimited; it's a constant challenge and I don't know if I can do it this time! For example, this month the car broke down and that wasn't planned, so part of my savings protection went to the repair. Despite these setbacks, nothing motivates me more than thinking about those 10 days of relaxation on the beach, which will undoubtedly be great. My financial direction needs a correction, but my main activity is dreaming of the sand and the sea.
text_tgt_raw: Estou a poupar há 6 meses para as minhas próximas férias e, honestamente, não é tarefa fácil. Todos os meses tenho o objetivo de guardar uma quantia fixa, mas surge sempre uma despesa inesperada e não consigo manter o plano. O problema é que adoro viajar e o meu orçamento não é ilimitado; é um desafio constante e não sei se consigo desta vez! Por exemplo, este mês o carro avariou e isso não estava previsto, por isso parte da minha proteção de poupança foi para a reparação. Apesar destes percalços, nada me motiva mais do que pensar naqueles 10 dias de relaxamento na praia, que serão, sem dúvida, ótimos. A minha direção financeira precisa de uma correção, mas a minha atividade principal é sonhar com a areia e o mar.
base_en: I've been saving for 6 months for my next vacation and, honestly, it's not easy at all. Every month I set out to save a fixed amount, but some unexpected expense always comes up and I can't stick to the plan. The problem is that I love to travel and my budget isn't unlimited. This is a constant challenge—I'm not sure if I'll make it this time! For example, this month the car broke down and that wasn't planned, so part of my savings went to the repair. Despite the setbacks, there's nothing that motivates me more than thinking about those 10 days of relaxation on the beach.

text_es: Learning a new language is an enriching activity that opens doors to other cultures and new ways of thinking. It's not just about memorizing vocabulary and grammar; it's an immersion into the essence of a community. Although it can be challenging at first, there is no greater reward than understanding and communicating fluently in another language. This is, without a doubt, an invaluable skill in today's world. You don't have to be a genius to achieve this goal; it just requires dedication and constant practice – we're not learning to pilot a spaceship. Furthermore, it doesn't have to be a solitary task, as there are great tools and resources available, from mobile apps to classes with native teachers. It's a project that, although sometimes not easy, is always rewarding and an action that enriches us.
text_tgt_raw: Aprender uma nova língua é uma atividade enriquecedora que abre portas para outras culturas e novas formas de pensar. Não se trata apenas de memorizar vocabulário e gramática; é uma imersão na essência de uma comunidade. Embora possa ser desafiante no início, não há maior recompensa do que entender e comunicar fluentemente noutro idioma. Esta é, sem dúvida, uma habilidade de valor inestimável no mundo atual. Não é preciso ser um génio para atingir este objetivo; apenas requer dedicação e prática constante – não estamos a aprender a pilotar uma nave espacial. Além disso, não tem de ser uma tarefa solitária, pois existem ótimas ferramentas e recursos disponíveis, desde aplicações móveis a aulas com professores nativos. É um projeto que, embora por vezes não seja fácil, é sempre compensador e uma ação que nos enriquece.
base_en: Learning a new language is an enriching experience that opens doors to other cultures and new ways of thinking. It's not just memorizing vocabulary and grammar; it's immersing oneself in the essence of a community. Although it can be challenging at 1st, there's no greater reward than understanding and communicating fluently in another language. This is, without a doubt, an invaluable skill in today's globalized world. You don't have to be a genius to achieve it, it just requires dedication and constant practice—you're not learning to pilot a spaceship. Furthermore, it doesn't have to be a solitary task; there are many tools and resources available, from mobile apps to classes with native teachers. It's a journey that, although sometimes not easy, is always worth it.

text_es: Starting to learn a new language, in my case Mandarin, is not an easy task, I assure you. In the beginning, the pronunciation seemed impossible to master; there are no sounds similar to Portuguese, which is quite frustrating. I remember the first week with the teacher, when I tried to imitate the tones and he would tell me, "No, it's not like that." I felt like I wasn't doing it right, despite my effort. After three months, I finally started to distinguish the tones and words, but even so, when I watch a movie without subtitles, I understand almost nothing. It's not that I haven't learned, but the speed and context are current challenges. I am determined to continue, because I know that mastery will come with constant practice, an essential factor for success in any activity. My goal is to have optimal comprehension, and I know that the way to get there is daily persistence.
text_tgt_raw: Começar a aprender uma nova língua, no meu caso o mandarim, não é uma tarefa fácil, garanto. No início, a pronúncia parecia impossível de dominar; não há sons parecidos com o português, o que é bastante frustrante. Lembro-me da primeira semana com o professor, quando tentava imitar os tons e ele me dizia: "Não, não é assim." Sentia que não estava a fazer um trabalho correto, apesar do meu esforço. Após três meses, comecei finalmente a distinguir os tons e as palavras, mas mesmo assim, quando vejo um filme sem legendas, não percebo quase nada. Não é que não tenha aprendido, mas a velocidade e o contexto são desafios atuais. Estou determinado a continuar, pois sei que o domínio virá com a prática constante, um fator essencial para o sucesso em qualquer atividade. O meu objetivo é ter uma compreensão ótima, e sei que a direção para lá chegar é a persistência diária.
base_en: Starting to learn a new language, Mandarin Chinese in my case, isn't an easy task, I assure you. At 1st, the pronunciation seemed impossible to master; there are no sounds similar to Spanish and that's frustrating. I remember the 1st week with the teacher, when I was trying to imitate the tones and he would tell me: "No, it's not like that." I felt like I wasn't doing it well, despite my effort. After 3 months, I finally started to distinguish the tones and words, but even so, when I watch a movie without subtitles, I don't understand almost anything. It's not that I haven't learned, but that speed and context are challenges. I'm determined to continue, because I know that mastery will come with constant practice.

text_es: Learning a new language is an extremely rewarding activity, but it is a project that requires time and dedication. Consistency and patience are essential; don't get discouraged if, at first, it seems like a challenge. Immersion is a crucial factor: listen to music, watch series or movies in the original version with subtitles, and try to speak from day one, even if it's just a few words. This is a direct action for progress. Don't underestimate the power of mistakes; they are part of the learning process, so don't be afraid to make them. Furthermore, there isn't one single correct methodology for everyone; experiment and discover what works best for you. With dedication, you will see that your goals will be achieved and, soon, you will be communicating fluently, feeling great.
text_tgt_raw: Aprender uma nova língua é uma atividade extremamente gratificante, mas é um projeto que exige tempo e dedicação. É fundamental ter consistência e paciência; não desanime se, no início, parecer um desafio. A imersão é um fator crucial: ouça música, veja séries ou filmes na versão original com legendas e tente falar desde o primeiro dia, mesmo que sejam apenas algumas palavras. Essa é uma ação direta para o progresso. Não subestime o poder dos erros; eles são parte do processo de aprendizagem, portanto, não tenha receio de os cometer. Além disso, não existe uma metodologia única e correta para todos; experimente e descubra o que funciona melhor para si. Com dedicação, verá que os seus objetivos serão alcançados e, em breve, estará a comunicar de forma fluente, sentindo-se ótimo.
base_en: Learning a new language is a very rewarding experience, but it's not something that happens overnight. You need consistency and patience; don't despair if it seems difficult at 1st. Immersion is key: listen to music, watch series or movies in their original version with subtitles, and try to speak from the 1st day, even if it's just a few words—that's essential. Don't underestimate the power of mistakes; you're learning and making mistakes is part of the process, so don't be afraid to make them. Furthermore, there isn't one single perfect methodology for everyone, experiment, and discover what works best for you. You'll see that with dedication, your progress has no limits and soon you'll be communicating fluently.

text_es: Participating in a popular race is a great way to get involved in a non-professional sports activity, open to everyone, regardless of their fitness level, as it's not an elite competition. Currently, these races cover predefined distances, such as 5 km or 10 km, through urban streets or natural routes, and there is no age limit for registration. The main goal is to enjoy the experience, promote healthy habits, and, in many cases, support a social cause, making each act a valuable contribution. Registration is not overly expensive and usually includes a bib, a commemorative t-shirt, and refreshments. It's an excellent opportunity to socialize and meet people with similar interests, an aspect I quite enjoy. Furthermore, the festive atmosphere and public encouragement transform participation into a very rewarding action.
text_tgt_raw: Participar numa corrida popular é uma ótima maneira de se envolver numa atividade desportiva não profissional, aberta a todos, independentemente do seu nível físico, pois não se trata de uma competição de elite. Atualmente, estas corridas cobrem distâncias predefinidas, como 5 km ou 10 km, através de ruas urbanas ou percursos naturais, e não há limite de idade para a inscrição. O objetivo principal é desfrutar da experiência, promover hábitos saudáveis e, em muitos casos, apoiar uma causa social, tornando cada ato numa contribuição valiosa. A inscrição não é excessivamente cara e geralmente inclui um dorsal, uma t-shirt comemorativa e refrescos. É uma oportunidade excelente para socializar e conhecer pessoas com interesses semelhantes, um aspeto que me agrada bastante. Além disso, a atmosfera festiva e o encorajamento do público transformam a participação numa ação muito gratificante.
base_en: Running a popular race is participating in a non-professional sporting event, open to everyone regardless of their physical level; it isn't an elite competition. Normally, predefined distances like 5 km or 10 km are covered through urban streets or paths, and there's no age limit to participate. The main objective is usually to enjoy the experience, promote healthy habits, and, in many cases, support a charitable cause; it isn't just for a personal best. Registration isn't excessively expensive and usually includes a bib, a commemorative t-shirt, and refreshments. It's an excellent opportunity to socialize and meet people with similar interests—this is something I really like. Furthermore, the festive atmosphere and the encouragement of the people make it a very rewarding experience; you won't regret it.

text_es: Restoring a piece of antique furniture is a rewarding activity that not only brings back its original beauty but also extends its lifespan. It is not a simple task, as it involves a series of meticulous actions, from deep cleaning and repairing structural damage to sanding and applying new finishes. It is crucial to identify the type of wood and the original finish to choose the correct products, given that not all are compatible with every material. Frequently, this is a project that requires patience and expertise, and one should not hesitate to ask for help if unsure. Furthermore, it is important to remember that traditional techniques, although not always the fastest, are the ones that offer optimal results. The ultimate goal is to return the furniture to its splendor without erasing the marks of time that give it character; the aim is not to make it look factory new.
text_tgt_raw: Restaurar uma peça de mobiliário antigo é uma atividade recompensadora que não só recupera a sua beleza original, mas também prolonga a sua vida útil. Não se trata de uma tarefa simples, pois envolve uma série de atos meticulosos, desde a limpeza profunda e a reparação de danos estruturais até ao lixar e aplicar novos acabamentos. É crucial identificar o tipo de madeira e o acabamento original para escolher os produtos corretos, dado que nem todos são compatíveis com cada material. Frequentemente, este é um projeto que exige paciência e perícia, e não se deve hesitar em pedir ajuda se não houver certeza. Além disso, é importante lembrar que as técnicas tradicionais, embora nem sempre as mais rápidas, são as que oferecem ótimos resultados. O objetivo final é devolver o mobiliário ao seu esplendor sem apagar as marcas do tempo que lhe conferem caráter; a direção não é torná-lo como novo de fábrica.
base_en: Restoring an antique piece of furniture is a rewarding process that not only recovers its original beauty, but also extends its useful life. It isn't a simple task, as it involves a series of meticulous steps, from deep cleaning and repairing structural damage to sanding and applying new finishes. It's important to identify the type of wood and the original finish to choose the right products, since not all of them are compatible with every material. Often, this is a job that requires patience and skill, and one shouldn't be afraid to ask for help if one isn't sure. Nor should one forget that traditional techniques are usually the ones that offer the best results, although they aren't always the fastest. The final goal is to return the furniture to its splendor without erasing the traces of time that give it character; it isn't about making it look factory new.

text_es: I remember the first time I tried to restore an old piece of furniture; it was a great learning experience. It was a small chest of drawers from my grandmother, and to be honest, it wasn't in very good condition. The drawers didn't close properly, and the wood wasn't a uniform color; it seemed to have a thousand stories to tell. At first, I didn't know where to start, but that didn't discourage me; I looked for online tutorials and asked for help from a friend who has more active knowledge about these things. I am proud of the result, because, although it is not perfect, it has enormous sentimental value for me. The chest of drawers is no longer in the attic; now it is beautifully displayed in the living room, and there isn't a day when I don't look at it with affection, thinking about the direction life takes us and the beauty we can give to objects we consider obsolete. Its current presence in the center of the room is a constant reminder of our family ties and the effort I invested.
text_tgt_raw: Lembro-me da primeira vez que tentei restaurar uma peça de mobiliário antiga; foi uma ótima experiência de aprendizagem. Era uma pequena cómoda da minha avó e, para ser sincero, não estava em muito bom estado. As gavetas não fechavam bem e a madeira não tinha uma cor uniforme, parecia ter mil histórias para contar. Numa primeira fase, não sabia por onde começar, mas isso não me desanimou; procurei tutoriais online e pedi ajuda a um amigo que tem um conhecimento mais ativo sobre estas coisas. Tenho orgulho do resultado, pois, embora não seja perfeito, tem um enorme valor sentimental para mim. A cómoda não está mais no sótão, agora exibe-se lindamente na sala de estar e não há um dia em que não a olhe com afeto, pensando na direção que a vida nos leva e na beleza que podemos dar a objetos que consideramos obsoletos. A sua atual presença no centro da sala é um lembrete constante dos nossos laços familiares e da atividade que investi.
base_en: I remember the 1st time I tried to restore an old piece of furniture, it was a learning experience. It was a small dresser from my grandmother, and it wasn't in very good condition, to be honest. The drawers didn't close well and the wood wasn't a uniform color, it seemed to have a thousand stories to tell. At 1st, I didn't know where to start, but this didn't discourage me; I looked for tutorials online and asked a friend who does know about these things. I'm proud of the result, although it's not perfect, it has a lot of sentimental value for me. The dresser is no longer in the attic, now it looks beautiful in the living room and there isn't a day that I don't look at it with affection.

text_es: To restore a piece of antique furniture, my first recommendation is to be well-informed, as it's not a task to be taken lightly. Start by researching the style and type of wood, a fundamental factor for choosing the correct products and avoiding damage to the piece. Don't rush; good planning is key. If you don't have a suitable space or basic tools, wait. A large workshop isn't essential, but a ventilated and clean area is great. Always do tests on a hidden part before applying any product to the main surface, to see the wood's reaction. If the furniture has woodworm, don't try to restore it without thoroughly treating it first – you won't want the infestation to spread. Remember that the goal isn't just to paint, but to restore its essence.
text_tgt_raw: Para restaurar uma peça de mobiliário antigo, a minha primeira recomendação é que se informe bem, pois não é uma tarefa a ser levada de ânimo leve. Comece por pesquisar o estilo e o tipo de madeira, um fator fundamental para escolher os produtos corretos e evitar danificar a peça. Não se apresse; um bom planeamento é a chave. Se não tiver um espaço adequado ou as ferramentas básicas, espere. Uma oficina grande não é essencial, mas uma área ventilada e limpa é ótima. Faça sempre testes numa parte escondida antes de aplicar qualquer produto na superfície principal, para ver a reação da madeira. Se o móvel tiver caruncho, não tente restaurá-lo sem antes o tratar a fundo – não vai querer que a infeção se espalhe. Lembre-se que o objetivo não é só pintar, mas sim restaurar a sua essência.
base_en: To restore an antique piece of furniture, my 1st recommendation is to inform yourself well; it's not a task that should be taken lightly. Start by researching the style and the wood, as this is fundamental for choosing the right products and not damaging the piece. Don't rush; good planning is key; if there isn't adequate space or you don't have the basic tools, wait. A large workshop isn't essential, but a ventilated and clean area is. Always do tests on a hidden part before applying any product to the main surface, because you don't know how the wood will react. If the furniture has woodworm, don't try to restore it without 1st treating it thoroughly—you don't want it to spread. Remember that it's not just about painting, but about restoring its essence.

text_es: Organizing a birthday party is an exciting activity, although it’s not as simple as it seems if the goal is for everything to go perfectly. First, you need to define the theme, the budget, and the guest list, which shouldn't be excessively long if you want something more intimate. The choice of venue is a crucial factor, as celebrating at home is not the same as renting a space; this is an aspect that requires planning. You also need to think about food and drinks—without forgetting allergies—as well as the decoration to create the desired atmosphere. To entertain those present, it’s a great idea to plan games or activities, especially if there are children, and it doesn't hurt to consider some music to liven up the atmosphere. Finally, good direction in the organization ensures that the host can also enjoy the celebration.
text_tgt_raw: Organizar uma festa de aniversário é uma atividade estimulante, embora não seja tão simples quanto parece se o objetivo é que tudo corra na perfeição. Em primeiro lugar, é preciso definir o tema, o orçamento e a lista de convidados, que não deve ser excessivamente longa se se pretende algo mais íntimo. A escolha do local é um fator crucial, pois celebrar em casa não é o mesmo que alugar um espaço; este é um aspeto que exige planeamento. Há também que pensar na comida e nas bebidas — sem esquecer as alergias — bem como na decoração para criar a atmosfera desejada. Para entreter os presentes, é uma ótima ideia planear jogos ou atividades, especialmente se houver crianças, e não custa considerar alguma música para animar o ambiente. Por fim, uma boa direção na organização garante que o anfitrião também possa desfrutar da celebração.
base_en: Organizing a birthday party is an exciting task, although it isn't as simple as it seems if you want everything to turn out perfectly. 1st, you must decide on the theme, the budget, and the guest list, which shouldn't be excessively long if you're looking for something intimate. The choice of venue is key, as celebrating at home isn't the same as renting a space; this is something that requires planning. You also have to think about the food and drinks—don't forget allergies—as well as the decoration to create the desired atmosphere. To entertain the attendees, it's a good idea to plan games or activities, especially if there are children, and it doesn't hurt to consider some music to set the mood. Finally, I'm sure that good organization guarantees that the host can also enjoy the celebration.

text_es: Organizing my 30th birthday party was a true odyssey—not easy, I tell you! First, the guest list: who can invite 30 people without breaking a sweat? Then, the venue: since I don't have a huge backyard, my immediate action was to look for a space big enough for everyone, which turned out to be the most complicated part, to be honest. A place for 10 is not the same as one for 30, and my goal was for no one to be without a good seat. The catering service wasn't straightforward either: the indecision between pizza or paella was a stress factor. I ended up adopting a mix to please everyone, although it's not certain if it was the optimal solution. What matters is that everyone has fun, right? That's the direction that really counts!
text_tgt_raw: Organizar a minha festa de 30 anos foi uma verdadeira odisseia – nada fácil, digo-vos! Primeiro, a lista de convidados: quem consegue convidar 30 pessoas sem transpirar? Depois, o local: como não tenho um jardim enorme, a minha ação imediata foi procurar um espaço com capacidade para todos, o que se revelou a parte mais complicada, para ser honesta. Um lugar para 10 não é o mesmo que um para 30, e o meu objetivo era que ninguém ficasse sem um bom lugar. O serviço de catering também não foi direto: a indecisão entre pizza ou paella foi um fator de stress. Acabei por adotar uma mistura para agradar a todos, embora não seja exato se foi a ótima solução. O que importa é que todos se divirtam, não é? Essa é a direção que realmente conta!
base_en: Planning my 30th birthday party was an odyssey—it wasn't easy at all! 1st, the guest list, who invites 30 people without breaking a sweat? Then, the venue: I don't have a huge garden, so I looked for a place with capacity for everyone; this is the most complicated part, honestly. A place for 10 isn't the same as one for 30. I didn't want anyone to be without a good seat. The catering wasn't simple either: I couldn't decide between pizza or paella. In the end, I opted for a mix to please everyone, although I'm not sure if it was the best idea. The important thing is that everyone has fun, right? That's what really matters!

text_es: Caring for houseplants is not as complicated as it seems, but it requires attention and basic knowledge. The first aspect to consider is light; not all plants need the same intensity, so it is essential to research the specific needs of each species so they don't burn or stop growing. Watering is equally crucial: there is no fixed rule, as this depends on the type of plant, the size of the pot, and the season, but, in general, it is preferable to water less than to overwater. Furthermore, ambient humidity and temperature are factors that cannot be ignored, especially for tropical plants. Don't forget occasional fertilization, especially in spring and summer, to provide them with nutrients they don't find in the substrate, contributing to optimal activity. This simple action ensures the healthy development and protection of your plants.
text_tgt_raw: Cuidar de plantas de interior não é tão complicado como parece, mas exige atenção e conhecimentos básicos. O primeiro aspeto a considerar é a luz; nem todas as plantas necessitam da mesma intensidade, por isso é essencial pesquisar as necessidades específicas de cada espécie para que não queimem ou deixem de crescer. A rega é igualmente crucial: não existe uma regra fixa, pois isto depende do tipo de planta, do tamanho do vaso e da estação, mas, em geral, é preferível regar menos do que em excesso. Além disso, a humidade ambiente e a temperatura são fatores que não podem ser ignorados, especialmente para plantas tropicais. Não se esqueça da fertilização ocasional, principalmente na primavera e no verão, para lhes fornecer os nutrientes que não encontram no substrato, contribuindo para uma ótima atividade. Esta ação simples garante o desenvolvimento saudável e a proteção das suas plantas.
base_en: Caring for houseplants isn't as complicated as it seems, but it does require attention and basic knowledge. The 1st thing to consider is light; not all plants need the same intensity, so it's essential to research the specific needs of each species so they don't burn or fail to grow. Watering is also crucial: there isn't a fixed rule, as this depends on the type of plant, the size of the pot, and the season, but in general, it's better to water less than excessively. Furthermore—this is important—ambient humidity and temperature are factors that can't be ignored, especially for tropical plants. Don't forget occasional fertilization, especially in spring and summer, to provide them with the nutrients they don't find in the potting soil.

text_es: For me, taking care of houseplants isn't just a hobby, it's almost a philosophy of life. I remember that, at first, this activity wasn't easy; my first two plants, poor things, didn't survive more than three weeks because I had no knowledge of their needs. Currently, about five years later, my house is a jungle; I have close to twenty plants and each one has its own personality and its peculiarities, I swear it's not an exaggeration. If one isn't happy, it immediately "tells me" with its leaves, and I, of course, am always attentive to these small aspects so that no bigger problems arise. It's not as complicated as it seems at first glance, you just need to observe them and give them a little affection. The direction towards a greener home is always a great choice.
text_tgt_raw: Cuidar de plantas de interior, para mim, não é apenas um passatempo, é quase uma filosofia de vida. Lembro-me que, no início, esta atividade não era fácil; as minhas duas primeiras plantas, coitadinhas, não sobreviveram mais de três semanas porque eu não tinha qualquer conhecimento das suas necessidades. Atualmente, passados cerca de cinco anos, a minha casa é uma selva; tenho perto de vinte plantas e cada uma possui a sua própria personalidade e as suas peculiaridades, juro que não é exagero. Se uma não está feliz, ela imediatamente "diz-me" com as suas folhas, e eu, claro, estou sempre atento a esses pequenos aspetos para que não surjam maiores problemas. Não é tão complicado como parece à primeira vista, basta observá-las e dar-lhes um pouco de afeto. A direção para um lar mais verde é sempre uma ótima escolha.
base_en: Taking care of houseplants, for me, isn't just a hobby, it's almost a philosophy of life. I remember that at 1st, this wasn't easy; my 1st 2 plants, poor things, didn't survive more than 3 weeks because I didn't know anything about their needs. Now, after about 5 years, my house is a jungle; I've about 20 plants and each one has its own personality and its quirks, I swear, this isn't an exaggeration. If one isn't happy, it immediately "tells" me with its leaves, and I, of course, am always attentive to those small details so that there aren't bigger problems. It isn't as complicated as it seems at 1st, you just have to observe them and give them a little love.

text_es: For success in indoor plant care, it's great not to overcomplicate things right from the start. The fundamental aspect is that they are not used to the outdoors, so you should provide them with a stable environment. This is crucial: research 2 or 3 basic needs for each plant you acquire—light, watering, and temperature—because not all are the same. Avoid overwatering; it's the main cause of death, and it's not easy to revive them afterward. My advice is to check the soil by touching it to see if it's dry before watering. Don't forget about ambient humidity; some plants don't tolerate it well, but others need it. I'm sure that with these tips, your indoor gardening activity will be a success and your plants will thrive.
text_tgt_raw: Para o sucesso no cuidado das plantas de interior, é ótimo não complicar as coisas logo de início. O aspeto fundamental é que elas não estão habituadas ao exterior, portanto, deve-se proporcionar-lhes um ambiente estável. Isto é crucial: pesquise 2 ou 3 necessidades básicas de cada planta que adquirir — luz, rega e temperatura — porque nem todas são iguais. Evite o excesso de água; é o fator principal de morte e não é fácil reanimá-las depois. A minha direção é que verifique o solo, tocando-o, para ver se está seco antes de regar. Não se esqueça da humidade ambiente; algumas plantas não a toleram bem, mas outras precisam dela. Tenho a certeza que, com estas dicas, a sua atividade de jardinagem interior será um sucesso e as suas plantas irão prosperar.
base_en: To successfully care for indoor plants, don't overcomplicate things at 1st. The fundamental thing is that they aren't used to the outdoors, so you have to give them a stable environment. This is crucial: research 2 or 3 basic needs of each plant you acquire—light, watering, temperature—because not all of them are the same. Don't overwater; it's the 1st cause of death, and it's not easy to revive them afterward. I advise you to touch the soil to check if it's dry before adding water. Don't forget about ambient humidity; some plants don't tolerate it well, but others need it. I'm sure that with these basic tips, your plants will thrive, and you won't have problems.

text_es: The choice of a mattress is not an act to be taken lightly, as it directly affects the quality of our rest and, consequently, our health. It is essential to consider several factors, such as the type of firmness, which is not the same for everyone; some will prefer a firmer one, while others will feel better on a softer one. We cannot forget the material: there are options with springs, memory foam, latex, or a combination of these, and each has its own support and breathability characteristics. Additionally, it is important to take into account our sleeping position – lying on your back is not the same as lying on your side – and if we share the bed, as it is not always easy to please two people. Finally, for an optimal experience, we should not underestimate the importance of trying out the mattress for a few minutes in the store; only then will we have an exact perception of its comfort. The right direction for restorative sleep begins with this careful selection.
text_tgt_raw: A escolha de um colchão não é um ato a ser tomado de ânimo leve, visto que afeta diretamente a qualidade do nosso descanso e, consequentemente, a nossa saúde. É fundamental considerar vários fatores, como o tipo de firmeza, que não é o mesmo para todos; alguns preferirão um mais firme, enquanto outros se sentirão melhor num mais macio. Não podemos esquecer o material: existem opções com molas, espuma viscoelástica, látex, ou uma combinação destas, e cada uma tem as suas próprias características de suporte e respirabilidade. Além disso, é importante ter em conta a nossa posição de dormir – deitar-se de costas não é o mesmo que deitar-se de lado – e se partilhamos a cama, pois nem sempre é fácil agradar a duas pessoas. Por fim, para uma ótima experiência, não devemos subestimar a importância de experimentar o colchão durante alguns minutos na loja; só assim teremos uma perceção exata do seu conforto. A direção certa para um sono reparador começa com esta seleção cuidadosa.
base_en: Choosing a mattress isn't a decision that should be taken lightly, as it directly affects the quality of our rest and, therefore, our health. It's essential to consider several factors, such as the type of firmness, which isn't the same for everyone; some will prefer a firmer one, while others will feel better on a softer one. Also, we can't forget the material: there are options with springs, memory foam, latex, or a combination of them, and each has its own support and breathability characteristics. Furthermore, it's important to consider our sleeping position—sleeping on your back isn't the same as sleeping on your side—and if we share the bed, since it's not always easy to please 2 people. Finally, we shouldn't underestimate the importance of trying the mattress for a few minutes in the store; you don't know how you'll feel until you try it.

text_es: When choosing a mattress, don't act hastily; it's not just any purchase. Several factors must be considered, as not all mattresses are the same, and this is a fundamental aspect for your rest. You don't need to buy the most expensive one; look for the one that best suits your specific needs. Think about your sleeping position – whether you sleep on your side, back, or stomach – because that dictates the necessary support. Don't forget to try it out for about 10 to 15 minutes in the store; truly, there's no better way to know if you'll feel comfortable. Furthermore, don't underestimate the importance of firmness, as the softest or hardest isn't always ideal. Making the right choice will ensure great results for your health and well-being. The need to prioritize quality sleep is current.
text_tgt_raw: Ao escolher um colchão, não aja precipitadamente; não é uma compra qualquer. Diversos fatores devem ser considerados, pois nem todos os colchões são iguais, e este é um aspeto fundamental para o seu descanso. Não precisa de comprar o mais caro, procure aquele que melhor se adequa às suas necessidades específicas. Pense na sua posição de sono – se dorme de lado, costas ou barriga – porque isso é a direção para o suporte necessário. Não se esqueça de o experimentar por cerca de 10 a 15 minutos na loja; verdadeiramente, não há melhor forma de saber se se sentirá confortável. Além disso, não subestime a importância da firmeza, já que o mais macio ou o mais duro nem sempre é o ideal. Uma ação correta na escolha garantirá ótimos resultados para a sua saúde e bem-estar. É atual a necessidade de se priorizar o sono de qualidade.
base_en: When you go to choose a mattress, don't rush; it's not just any purchase. Several factors must be considered, since not all mattresses are the same, and this is fundamental for your rest. You don't have to buy the most expensive one, look for the one that best suits your specific needs. Think about your sleeping position—if you're on your side, back, or stomach—because that's key for the support you need. Don't forget to try it for about 10 to 15 minutes in the store; truly, there's no better way to know if you'll feel comfortable. Also, don't underestimate the importance of firmness, since the softest or hardest isn't always ideal.

text_es: Reducing food waste is an essential action for sustainability, bringing environmental benefits and a positive economic impact. This is not a minor problem, as about one-third of all food produced globally is lost or wasted annually, which is alarming, given that many people do not have access to adequate food. It is obvious that food production consumes large amounts of resources, such as water and energy, and its waste implies inefficiency throughout the entire chain. There is no single solution, but we can start by better planning purchases, storing food correctly, and using leftovers, which is not as complicated as it seems. It is fundamental to increase awareness in society about this global challenge, as we cannot continue with this unsustainable rate of consumption. The direction we take now is crucial for the future, and every action counts towards achieving a more optimal and equitable food system.
text_tgt_raw: A redução do desperdício alimentar é uma ação essencial para a sustentabilidade, trazendo benefícios ambientais e um impacto económico positivo. Não se trata de um problema menor, pois cerca de um terço de toda a comida produzida globalmente é perdida ou desperdiçada anualmente, o que é alarmante, dado que muitas pessoas não têm acesso a alimentação adequada. É óbvio que a produção alimentar consome grandes quantidades de recursos, como água e energia, e o seu desperdício implica ineficiência em toda a cadeia. Não existe uma solução única, mas podemos começar por planear melhor as compras, armazenar os alimentos corretamente e utilizar os restos, o que não é tão complicado como parece. É fundamental aumentar a consciencialização na sociedade sobre este desafio global, pois não podemos continuar com esta taxa de consumo insustentável. A direção que tomarmos agora é crucial para o futuro, e cada ato conta para alcançar um sistema alimentar mais ótimo e equitativo.
base_en: Reducing food waste is crucial for sustainability; it not only benefits the environment but also has a positive economic impact. It isn't a minor problem, as 1/3 of all food produced globally is lost or wasted annually. This is alarming if we consider that many people don't have access to adequate food. We can't ignore that food production consumes large quantities of resources like water and energy, and its waste implies inefficiency throughout the entire chain. There isn't a single solution, but we can start by better planning purchases, properly storing food, and utilizing leftovers; it isn't as complicated as it seems. It's important to raise awareness in society about this global challenge; we can't afford to continue with this unsustainable consumption rate.

text_es: The other day, while preparing dinner for 4 people, I realized how much food we would throw away if I didn't change my habits. I hadn't realized until that moment what reducing waste truly means. Before, I didn't care much if there was something left over; I thought it wasn't a problem, that it wouldn't be that serious. However, nowadays I don't see things that way. I decided I couldn't continue with that attitude, so I started planning meals in a more correct way and being more creative with leftovers; that's a great action we should all adopt. For example, with one day's roasted chicken, I didn't throw away what was left over, but made some delicious fritters the next day; I'm very proud of that invention! Really, reducing food waste isn't as difficult as it seems, and the planet will thank us for it.
text_tgt_raw: No outro dia, enquanto preparava o jantar para 4 pessoas, apercebi-me de quanta comida iríamos deitar fora se não mudasse os meus hábitos. Não tinha percebido até àquele momento o que realmente significa reduzir o desperdício. Antes, não me importava muito se sobrava algo; pensava que não era um problema, que não seria algo tão sério. No entanto, atualmente não vejo as coisas dessa forma. Decidi que não podia continuar com essa atitude, então comecei a planear as refeições de uma forma mais correta e a ser mais criativa com as sobras; essa é uma ótima ação que todos devíamos adotar. Por exemplo, com o frango assado de um dia, não deitei fora o que sobrou, mas fiz umas deliciosas pataniscas no dia seguinte; estou muito orgulhosa dessa invenção! Realmente, reduzir o desperdício alimentar não é tão difícil como parece, e o planeta vai agradecer-nos por isso.
base_en: The other day, preparing dinner for 4 people, I realized how much food we were going to throw away if I didn't change my habits. I didn't realize until that moment what reducing waste really means. Before, I didn't care too much if there was something left over; I thought that wasn't a problem, that it isn't something so serious. However, now I don't see it that way. I decided I couldn't continue with that attitude, so I started to plan meals better and to be more creative with leftovers; that's something we should all do. For example, with the roasted chicken from one day, I didn't throw away what was left, but instead I made some delicious croquettes the next day; I'm very proud of that invention! Really, reducing food waste isn't as difficult as it seems, and the planet is going to thank us for it.

text_es: To reduce food waste, good planning is essential and not as difficult as it seems, with optimal benefits. Before going shopping, thoroughly inspect your refrigerator and pantry—this way you'll avoid duplicate purchases—and make a list of what you really need; this is a key factor in not overspending. At the supermarket, don't be swayed by offers you won't actually use, and remember that bigger isn't always better if you don't consume it later. At home, organize food so that older products or those with closer expiration dates are more accessible—you don't want them to spoil. Finally, don't throw away leftovers; yesterday's meal doesn't have to be boring if you give it a new direction with a little imagination, thus adopting more sustainable and active behavior.
text_tgt_raw: Para reduzir o desperdício alimentar, um bom planeamento é essencial e não é tão difícil quanto parece, sendo o benefício ótimo. Antes de ir às compras, faça uma inspeção rigorosa ao frigorífico e à despensa – desta forma evitará compras duplicadas – e faça uma lista do que realmente necessita; este é um fator chave para não gastar em demasia. No supermercado, não se deixe levar por ofertas de que não fará um uso efetivo, e lembre-se que maior nem sempre é melhor se não o consumir depois. Em casa, organize os alimentos de modo a que os produtos mais antigos ou com datas de validade mais próximas fiquem mais acessíveis – não quer que se estraguem. Finalmente, não deite fora as sobras; a refeição de ontem não tem de ser aborrecida se lhe der uma nova direção com um pouco de imaginação, adotando assim um comportamento mais sustentável e ativo.

When you're at the supermarket, don't get carried away by offers that you won't fully use, and remember that bigger isn't always better if you don't consume it later. At home, organize food so that older products or those with closer expiration dates are more accessible—you don't want them to spoil. Finally, don't throw away leftovers; yesterday's food doesn't have to be boring if you give it new life with a little imagination.

text_es: Learning to swim as an adult is a rewarding experience that, nowadays, is not as complicated as some people think. Many feel intimidated, believing they can't do it, but there is no age limit to acquire this essential skill. There are numerous sports centers that offer specific classes for adults, focused on overcoming fear of water and teaching basic techniques; it doesn't have to be a solitary process. The important thing is to start calmly, without pressure; this is a fundamental factor for building confidence. You are not alone in this, many adults share this goal, and progress is usually great. It is an action that not only improves physical condition but also offers a great sense of safety and freedom in the water.

Existem inúmeros centros desportivos que oferecem aulas específicas para adultos, focadas em superar o medo da água e ensinar técnicas básicas; não tem de ser um processo solitário. text_es: Learning to swim as an adult is a peculiar experience; it's not the same as when you're a child, I assure you! I always thought it wasn't for me, that it was too late. But one summer, at 35, I decided to enroll in a course, and it wasn't easy, I won't lie. At first, I was terrified of the deep end and couldn't relax in the water. My instructor, however, was very patient, and always told me: "There's no rush, it's a gradual process." Nowadays, I can say that I swim with a certain ease and I don't regret doing it; it's a great feeling of freedom. So, if you're thinking of learning, don't hesitate, this is a worthwhile action that has a direct impact on well-being! It's a goal achieved with dedication, and the reward is a new range of activities that open up. The direction our lives take sometimes depends on these acts of courage.

text_es: Learning to swim as an adult is a rich and liberating experience; it's never too late to start! Consistency and overcoming fear are key: it's not impossible! If you are patient with yourself, you will surely notice your progress and achieve your goal. Your safety and well-being are always a priority in this learning process.

text_es: Painting a room is not a complicated task if there is good organization. First, you need to prepare the surface, which is not always the most fun, but it is a fundamental step: clean the walls, fill holes or cracks, and sand if necessary. We must not forget to protect the floor and furniture with drop cloths or plastic; this action is crucial to avoid stains. Then, we should select the appropriate paint and tools; the direction of the roller is not the same as the brush for the corners, for example. Normally, two or three coats of paint are applied, allowing drying time between each one—this is great for a good finish. The final result, which updates the space, is always gratifying, giving it a completely new look and a feeling of renewal that is achieved with minimal effort.
text_tgt_raw: Pintar uma divisão não é uma tarefa complicada se houver uma boa organização. Em primeiro lugar, é preciso preparar a superfície, o que nem sempre é o mais divertido, mas é um passo fundamental: limpar as paredes, tapar buracos ou rachadelas e lixar, se necessário. Não nos podemos esquecer de proteger o chão e os móveis com telas ou plástico; esta ação é crucial para evitar manchas. Depois, devemos selecionar a tinta e as ferramentas adequadas; a direção do rolo não é a mesma do pincel para os cantos, por exemplo. Normalmente, aplicam-se duas ou três camadas de tinta, permitindo o tempo de secagem entre cada uma — isso é ótimo para um bom acabamento. O resultado final, que atual o espaço, é sempre gratificante, dando-lhe um aspeto completamente novo e uma sensação de renovação que se consegue com um mínimo de esforço.
base_en: Painting a room isn't a complicated task if one organizes well. 1st, you have to prepare the surface, which isn't always fun, but it's essential: clean the walls, patch holes or cracks, and sand if necessary. You mustn't forget to protect the floor and furniture with tarps or plastic; this is crucial to avoid stains. Then, we select the appropriate paint and tools; using a roller isn't the same as using a brush for the edges. Normally, 2, or 3 coats of paint are applied, allowing drying time between each one—that's fundamental for a good finish. I'm sure the final result is gratifying, as it gives the space a completely new feel.

text_es: It's not my favorite activity, but last week I had to paint the guest room. I really didn't like the previous color—it was a horrible pistachio green—so I decided to change it to a light blue. That part wasn't difficult, honestly, but moving the furniture was a torment for me; there's no way to do it without help! I bought 15 liters of paint and 3 rollers, thinking I wouldn't need more. I'm very proud of the final result; the transformation is remarkable and it looks great, it doesn't even seem like the same room, and I'm not even an expert! My back, on the other hand, isn't so happy, but it was an act of dedication that was worth it. The direction the project took was excellent, and now the space has new life, which shows that a good color selection makes all the difference.

text_es: When starting to paint a room, prior planning is an essential factor, as it's not just about choosing the color. The first step will be to gather all the materials: paint, brushes, rollers, painter's tape, and protective plastic sheets; this is a measure that will prove excellent for ensuring a clean and professional-looking finish. It's important not to forget to prepare the surface: clean it thoroughly, correct any imperfections, and lightly sand it so the paint adheres correctly. Protecting furniture and floors is something that should not be underestimated, to avoid unwanted stains. Start with the ceiling, then the walls, and finally the baseboards; this way, you avoid dripping on already painted surfaces. A second coat is usually necessary, but it's not an exact rule; it depends on the color and quality of the paint. You'll see that, with good guidance, it's not as complicated as it seems!
text_tgt_raw: Ao iniciar a pintura de uma divisão, um planeamento prévio é um fator essencial, pois não se trata apenas de escolher a cor. O primeiro ato será reunir todos os materiais: tinta, pincéis, rolos, fita-cola de pintor e plásticos de proteção; esta é uma medida que se revelará ótima para garantir um acabamento limpo e com aspeto profissional. É importante não esquecer de preparar a superfície: limpá-la bem, corrigir quaisquer imperfeições e lixar levemente para que a tinta adira corretamente. A proteção de móveis e pavimentos é algo que não deve ser subestimado, para evitar manchas indesejadas. Comece pelo teto, depois as paredes, e por fim os rodapés; desta forma, evita pingar em superfícies já pintadas. Uma segunda demão é geralmente necessária, mas não é uma regra exata; depende da cor e da qualidade da tinta. Verá que, com uma boa direção, não é tão complicado como parece!

Don't forget to prepare the surface: clean it well, repair any imperfections, and sand lightly so that the paint adheres better. One shouldn't underestimate the importance of protecting furniture and floors; you don't want unwanted stains. Start with the ceiling, then the walls, and finally the baseboards; this way, you won't be dripping on already painted surfaces. A 2nd coat is usually necessary, but it isn't always the case; it depends on the color and quality. You'll see that it isn't as complicated as it seems!

text_es: Starting meditation isn't as complicated as it seems and doesn't require prior experience. It's an ancient practice that offers numerous benefits for mental and physical health, and this is not a myth. To begin, find a quiet place where you won't be disturbed, sit comfortably—a specific posture isn't necessary—and close your eyes. The crucial aspect is to focus on your breathing, feeling how the air enters and leaves; don't worry if your mind wanders, it's a natural act. When that happens, simply redirect your attention to your breath without judging yourself; the goal isn't to evaluate yourself. You don't need to meditate for an hour all at once; 5 or 10 minutes a day is a great start to establish this habit, and the positive effects will be detected quickly. Your current quality of life can greatly improve with this simple activity.
text_tgt_raw: Iniciar a meditação não é tão complicado como parece e não exige experiência prévia. Trata-se de uma prática antiga que oferece inúmeros benefícios para a saúde mental e física, e isto não é um mito. Para começar, encontre um lugar tranquilo onde não será incomodado, sente-se confortavelmente — uma postura específica não é necessária — e feche os olhos. O aspeto crucial é focar-se na sua respiração, sentindo como o ar entra e sai; não se preocupe se a sua mente divagar, é um ato natural. Quando isso acontecer, simplesmente redirecione a sua atenção para a respiração sem se julgar; o objetivo não é avaliar-se. Não precisa de meditar por uma hora de uma só vez; 5 ou 10 minutos por dia são um ótimo começo para estabelecer este hábito, e os efeitos positivos serão detetados rapidamente. A sua atual qualidade de vida pode melhorar bastante com esta simples atividade.

When that happens, simply redirect your attention to your breathing without judging yourself; you're not there to evaluate yourself. You don't have to meditate for 1 hour all at once, 5, or 10 minutes a day are an excellent start to establishing a habit.

text_es: I started meditating about 3 months ago, and honestly, it wasn't easy at first. My mind wasn't used to being silent; I didn't know how to do it. In the first few days, I felt a little frustrated because my thoughts wouldn't stop; they told me that's a common aspect. My concentration wasn't very good; I couldn't focus on my breath for more than 30 seconds. Nowadays, it's not that I'm an expert, but I can stay calm for 10 minutes straight without a problem. It's a great tool for managing stress; I believe it's an activity everyone should try. Protecting our mental health is a primary goal, and this practice can have a positive effect. In fact, the correct direction for a more balanced life can involve these simple actions.

text_es: When preparing for a job interview, the first thing to keep in mind is to conduct exhaustive research on the company. This action will not only help you answer better, but will also demonstrate your genuine interest, which is a crucial factor. Review the job description and think of 2 or 3 concrete examples where your skills align perfectly with the company's objectives. There is nothing worse than appearing unprepared, so practice your answers to common questions and don't forget to prepare 3 or 4 intelligent questions to ask the interviewer. Remember that it's not just an evaluation of you; you are also evaluating whether the company is the right place for you. Last but not least, do not underestimate the importance of punctuality and a good presentation — these are always great qualities!

Não há nada pior do que parecer despreparado, por isso, pratique as suas respostas a perguntas comuns e não se esqueça de elaborar 3 ou 4 questões inteligentes para colocar ao entrevistador. Por último, mas não menos importante, não subestime a importância da pontualidade e de uma boa apresentação — são sempre ótimas qualidades!
