text_es: For those who want to start the activity of making bread at home, a great and rewarding hobby, the first action to take is to select a simple recipe, ideally without sourdough, which requires more practice and time. It is essential to choose quality ingredients—flour, water, salt, and yeast—as they are the basis for good bread. One should not obsess over perfect kneading at first; this technique is acquired with experience, and there are many useful videos available online to help. Pay attention to the water temperature and the proofing time, as these are crucial factors that will influence the final texture. A kitchen thermometer, being a very useful object, can be your best friend. Do not hesitate to experiment with different types of flour, such as whole wheat or spelt, and remember that practice leads to perfection.
text_tgt_raw: Para quem deseja iniciar a atividade de fazer pão em casa, um passatempo ótimo e recompensador, a primeira ação a tomar é selecionar uma receita simples, idealmente sem massa-mãe, que exige mais prática e tempo. É essencial escolher ingredientes de qualidade — farinha, água, sal e levedura — pois são a base para um bom pão. Não se deve obcecar com a amassadura perfeita no início; esta técnica adquire-se com a experiência, e há muitos vídeos úteis disponíveis online para ajudar. Preste atenção à temperatura da água e ao tempo de levedação, pois são fatores cruciais que influenciarão a textura final. Um termómetro de cozinha, sendo um objeto muito útil, pode ser o seu melhor amigo. Não hesite em experimentar diferentes tipos de farinha, como trigo integral ou espelta, e lembre-se que a prática leva à perfeição.
base_en: If you're going to start baking bread at home—a very rewarding hobby—the 1st thing is to choose a simple recipe, preferably without sourdough—which requires more practice and time. Look for quality ingredients—flour, water, salt, and yeast—as they're the basis of good bread. Don't obsess over perfect kneading at 1st—the technique is acquired with experience—; there are many useful videos online. Pay attention to the water temperature and the proofing time—crucial factors—, as they'll influence the final texture. A kitchen thermometer—very useful—can be your best friend. Don't be afraid to experiment with different types of flour—whole wheat, spelled...—and remember that practice makes perfect.

text_es: Adopting a dog is an act of love and responsibility, an important decision that offers a second chance to a homeless animal. Currently, there are thousands of dogs of all ages, breeds, and sizes waiting to find a family that will provide them with affection and care. When deciding to adopt, it is crucial to consider the commitment of time and resources, such as food and vet visits, that having a pet entails. Many animal protection associations facilitate this process by conducting interviews and checking the conditions of the future home to ensure the adoption is suitable. The benefits are mutual: the animal receives a dignified life, far from abandonment, and the adopter enjoys the unconditional companionship and affection that only an animal can offer. It is a great and enriching experience for both, strengthening the human-animal bond and promoting responsible pet ownership.
text_tgt_raw: A adoção de um cão é um ato de amor e responsabilidade, uma decisão importante que oferece uma segunda oportunidade a um animal sem lar. Atualmente, existem milhares de cães de todas as idades, raças e tamanhos à espera de encontrar uma família que lhes proporcione afeto e cuidado. Ao decidir adotar, é crucial considerar o compromisso de tempo e recursos, como alimentação e visitas ao veterinário, que ter um animal de estimação implica. Muitas associações de proteção animal facilitam este processo, realizando entrevistas e verificando as condições do futuro lar para garantir a adequação da adoção. Os benefícios são mútuos: o animal recebe uma vida digna, longe do abandono, e o adotante desfruta da companhia incondicional e do carinho que só um animal pode oferecer. É uma experiência ótima e enriquecedora para ambos, que fortalece o vínculo humano-animal e promove a posse responsável.
base_en: Adopting a dog is an act of love and responsibility—an important decision—that offers a 2nd chance to a homeless animal. There are thousands of dogs—of all ages, breeds, and sizes—waiting to find a family that will give them affection and care for them. When deciding to adopt, it's crucial to consider the commitment of time and resources—such as food and vet visits—that having a pet entails. Many shelters—or animal rescues—facilitate this process, conducting interviews and verifying the conditions of the future home to ensure the suitability of the adoption. The benefits are mutual: the animal receives a dignified life—far from abandonment—and the adopter enjoys the unconditional companionship and affection that only a pet can offer. It's an enriching experience—for both the dog and the family—that strengthens the human-animal bond and promotes responsible pet ownership.

text_es: When I decided to adopt a dog—an idea that had been developing for two years—I didn't imagine how much this action would change my life. I went to the shelter for the first time with my sister, who is a great animal advocate, and I came across a small, 8-month-old mixed-breed dog with the saddest eyes I had ever seen. It was a moment of great affection. Initially, he was a little nervous, which is natural, but after three visits, each one more rewarding than the last, I knew he was the perfect dog for me. The adoption process was quite simple, as the shelter staff were very helpful, and in just two days he was already home. Since then, every morning, he is my great alarm clock, waking me up with licks and that happy look that makes me feel like I made the best decision of my life.
text_tgt_raw: Quando decidi adotar um cão — uma ideia que amadurecia há dois anos — não imaginava o quanto essa ação mudaria a minha vida. Fui ao canil pela primeira vez com a minha irmã, que é uma grande protetora de animais, e deparei-me com um pequeno cão de raça indefinida, de 8 meses, com os olhos mais tristes que já vi. Foi um momento de grande afeto. Inicialmente, ele estava um pouco nervoso, o que é natural, mas após três visitas, cada uma mais gratificante que a anterior, soube que era o cão perfeito para mim. O processo de adoção foi bastante simples, pois os colaboradores do canil foram muito atenciosos, e em apenas dois dias ele já estava em casa. Desde então, todas as manhãs, ele é o meu ótimo despertador, acordando-me com lambidelas e aquele olhar feliz que me faz sentir que tomei a decisão mais correta da minha vida.
base_en: When I decided to adopt a dog—an idea I'd been mulling over for 2 years—I didn't know how much it would change my life. I went to the shelter for the 1st time with my sister—she's an animal lover—and I saw a small 8-month-old mixed breed, with the saddest eyes I've ever seen—it was moving. At 1st, he was a little nervous—that's normal, I think—but after 3 visits—each one more rewarding than the last—I knew he was the one for me. The adoption process was simple—the shelter staff was very friendly—and in 2 days he was already home with me. Since then, every morning—he's the best alarm clock—he wakes me up with licks and that happy look that makes me feel like I made the best decision of my life.

text_es: When considering adopting a dog, a decision that will have a direct impact on your life, it's great to reflect on your lifestyle and available space. Try to learn about breeds, or even mixed-breed dogs, which are equally wonderful, and their specific exercise and care needs. Before bringing them home, prepare everything necessary and make sure you have the financial resources and time for their food, vet visits, and training. Patience is a crucial factor during the adaptation period, especially with puppies or dogs with past traumas. Establish clear routines from day one, as this contributes to the animal's security, and provide them with a safe environment and lots of affection. Remember that it's a lifelong commitment, usually 10 to 15 years, and the reward is unconditional love; your reaction will be pure joy.
text_tgt_raw: Ao considerar a adoção de um cão, uma decisão que terá um impacto direto na sua vida, é ótimo refletir sobre o seu estilo de vida e o espaço disponível. Procure informar-se sobre as raças, ou até sobre os cães de raça indefinida, que são igualmente maravilhosos, e as suas necessidades específicas de exercício e cuidado. Antes de o levar para casa, prepare tudo o que é necessário e certifique-se de que tem os recursos financeiros e o tempo para a sua alimentação, visitas ao veterinário e treino. A paciência é um fator crucial durante o período de adaptação, especialmente com cachorros ou cães com traumas passados. Estabeleça rotinas claras desde o primeiro dia, pois isso contribui para a segurança do animal, e proporcione-lhe um ambiente seguro e muito afeto. Lembre-se que é um compromisso para toda a vida, normalmente de 10 a 15 anos, e a recompensa é um amor incondicional, a sua reação será de pura alegria.
base_en: When adopting a dog—an important decision that will change your life—consider your lifestyle and the available space. Research breeds—or mixed breeds, which are just as wonderful—and their specific exercise and care needs. Before bringing it home—prepare everything necessary—make sure you've the financial resources and time for its food, vet visits, and training. Patience is key during the adaptation period—especially with puppies or dogs with past traumas. Establish clear routines from day 1—this helps the animal's security—and provide it with a safe environment and lots of affection. Remember that it's a lifelong commitment—normally 10 to 15 years—and the reward is unconditional love.

text_es: Assembling a shelf unit—a common activity in many homes—involves organizing and attaching its components to create a functional storage structure. Generally, the process begins with identifying all the parts (shelves, posts, screws, etc.) and carefully reading the manufacturer's instructions, a step I consider excellent for avoiding mistakes. It is currently recommended to have the appropriate tools (screwdriver, hammer, or Allen wrench) on hand before starting. Assembly follows a logical direction: first, the sides or posts are joined, then the shelves are inserted, securing them firmly, and finally, the stability of the structure is checked. It is correct to ensure that all screws are well tightened, without overdoing it to avoid damaging the material, and that the shelf unit is level. In some cases, it may be necessary to anchor it to the wall, especially taller or heavier ones, for protection against accidents. This act of precaution is a fundamental objective for safety.
text_tgt_raw: A montagem de uma estante — uma atividade comum em muitos lares — implica organizar e fixar os seus componentes para criar uma estrutura de armazenamento funcional. Geralmente, a ação começa com a identificação de todas as peças (prateleiras, postes, parafusos, etc.) e a leitura atenta das instruções do fabricante, um passo que considero ótimo para evitar erros. É atualmente recomendado ter as ferramentas apropriadas (chave de fendas, martelo ou chave Allen) à mão antes de iniciar. A montagem segue uma direção lógica: primeiro, as laterais ou postes são unidos, depois as prateleiras são inseridas, fixando-as firmemente, e, finalmente, a estabilidade da estrutura é verificada. É correto certificar-se de que todos os parafusos estão bem apertados, sem exagerar para não danificar o material, e que a estante está nivelada. Em alguns casos, pode ser necessário ancorá-la à parede, sobretudo as mais altas ou pesadas, para a proteção contra acidentes. Este ato de precaução é um objetivo fundamental para a segurança.
base_en: Assembling a shelf unit—a common task in many homes—involves organizing and securing its components to create a functional storage structure. Generally, the process begins with identifying all the parts—boards, posts, screws, etc.—and carefully reading the manufacturer's instructions—a crucial step to avoid errors. It's recommended to have the appropriate tools—screwdriver, hammer, or Allen wrench—on hand before starting. Assembly usually follows a logical order: 1st, the sides or posts are joined, then the shelves are inserted—securing them firmly—and, finally, the stability of the structure is checked. It's important to make sure all screws are tightened properly—without over-tightening to avoid damaging the material—and that the shelf unit is level. In some cases, it may be necessary to anchor it to the wall—especially taller or heavier ones—to prevent accidents.

text_es: Last week, I started a seemingly simple project to assemble a bookshelf and organize my collections. Upon opening the box, I was confronted with twenty wooden pieces—all identical in appearance—and a bag full of screws and dowels. The instruction manual, written in five languages, was a labyrinth of confusing diagrams, and after thirty minutes of frustration, with my cat watching with interest, I hadn't managed to assemble anything. I decided to ignore the instructions, an action I would later regret, and follow my intuition, which resulted in two inverted supports and one broken piece. In the end, two and a half hours later, and with a hammer in hand, the bookshelf was standing, a little crooked, but functional, which was a great result given the circumstances and my current lack of experience.
text_tgt_raw: Na semana passada, iniciei um projeto que parecia simples para montar uma estante de livros e organizar as minhas coleções. Ao abrir a caixa, deparei-me com vinte peças de madeira – todas de aspeto idêntico – e um saco repleto de parafusos e cavilhas. O manual de instruções, escrito em cinco idiomas, era um labirinto de diagramas confusos, e após trinta minutos de frustração, com o meu gato a observar com interesse, não tinha conseguido efetuar qualquer montagem. Decidi ignorar as instruções, uma ação de que me arrependeria mais tarde, e seguir a minha intuição, o que resultou em dois suportes invertidos e uma peça partida. No fim, duas horas e meia depois, e com um martelo na mão, a estante estava de pé, um pouco torta, mas funcional, o que foi um resultado ótimo dadas as circunstâncias e a minha falta de experiência atual.
base_en: Last week I set out to assemble a bookshelf—a project that seemed simple at 1st—to organize my books. I opened the box and found 20 pieces of wood—all identical in appearance—and a bag full of screws and dowels. The instruction manual—written in 5 different languages—was a labyrinth of confusing diagrams, and after 30 minutes of frustration—with my cat watching with interest—I hadn't managed to assemble anything. I decided to ignore the instructions—a decision I would regret later—and follow my intuition, which resulted in 2 upside-down supports and 1 broken piece. In the end, 2½ hours later—and with 1 hammer in hand—the bookshelf was standing, a bit crooked, but functional.

text_es: Assembling a shelf, a very rewarding home project, requires preparation and patience. Before starting any action, and to avoid surprises, check that you have all the parts and tools indicated in the manual; a checklist, always useful, is great for this purpose. Follow the instructions step by step, without skipping any, and make sure to tighten all screws well to ensure stability. A spirit level is an indispensable item to ensure the shelves are perfectly straight. If you encounter difficulties, which is common, don't get frustrated; look for online tutorials or ask someone with more experience for help. With a little care, you will enjoy your shelf, a practical and aesthetic piece of furniture, for many years.
text_tgt_raw: Montar uma prateleira, um projeto bastante gratificante para o lar, exige preparação e paciência. Antes de iniciar qualquer ação, e para evitar surpresas, verifique que possui todas as peças e ferramentas indicadas no manual; uma lista de verificação, sempre útil, é ótima para este efeito. Siga as instruções passo a passo, sem saltar nenhum, e certifique-se de apertar bem todos os parafusos para assegurar a estabilidade. Um nível de bolha é um objeto indispensável para que as prateleiras fiquem perfeitamente retas. Se detetar dificuldades, o que é comum, não se frustre; procure tutoriais online ou peça ajuda a alguém com mais experiência. Com um pouco de cuidado, desfrutará da sua prateleira, um móvel prático e estético, por muitos anos.
base_en: When assembling a shelf—a rewarding project for any home—the key lies in preparation and patience. Before starting—to avoid surprises—verify that you've all the parts and tools indicated in the manual; a checklist—always useful—is ideal for this. Follow the instructions step by step—without skipping any—and make sure to tighten all the screws well—but don't overdo it—to ensure stability. A spirit level is indispensable—believe me, it makes a difference—so that the shelves are perfectly straight. If you encounter difficulties—which is common, don't get frustrated—look for online tutorials or ask someone with more experience for help. With a little care, you'll enjoy your shelf—a practical and aesthetic piece of furniture—for many years.

text_es: Saving for vacation, a common goal for many, is essential to enjoy a well-deserved rest without financial worries. Advance planning is key—ideally several months in advance—by setting a clear budget that considers all possible expenses: transportation, accommodation, food, and activities. An effective strategy involves creating a specific fund, for example, a separate savings account, to which a fixed amount is allocated monthly. Reducing unnecessary expenses, such as daily coffees or eating out, can free up a surprising amount of money over time. Considering more economical travel alternatives, such as off-peak flights or accommodations with kitchens, also directly contributes to savings. Furthermore, looking for offers and discounts in advance, especially on flights and hotels, can generate a savings of up to 20% on the total cost, making it great. By following these actions, the dream of a perfect, debt-free vacation becomes a present reality. Adopting these measures is crucial for successful financial management, which will have a positive effect on your life.
text_tgt_raw: Poupar para as férias, um objetivo comum a muitos, é fundamental para desfrutar de um merecido descanso sem preocupações financeiras. O planeamento antecipado é a chave – idealmente com vários meses de antecedência – estabelecendo um orçamento claro que considere todas as despesas possíveis: transporte, alojamento, alimentação e atividades. Uma estratégia eficaz consiste em criar um fundo específico, por exemplo, uma conta poupança separada, para a qual se aloca um montante fixo mensalmente. Reduzir gastos desnecessários, como cafés diários ou refeições fora, pode libertar uma quantia surpreendente de dinheiro ao longo do tempo. Considerar alternativas de viagem mais económicas, como voos fora da época alta ou alojamentos com cozinha, também contribui de forma direta para a poupança. Além disso, procurar ofertas e descontos com antecedência, especialmente em voos e hotéis, pode gerar uma exceção de até 20% no custo total, tornando-o ótimo. Ao seguir estes atos, o sonho de umas férias perfeitas e sem dívidas torna-se uma realidade atual. A adoção destas medidas é crucial para uma gestão financeira de sucesso, que terá um efeito positivo na sua vida.
base_en: Saving for vacation—a goal desired by many—is fundamental to enjoying a well-deserved rest without financial worries. Planning in advance is key—ideally several months in advance—establishing a clear budget that considers all possible expenses—transportation, accommodation, food, and activities. An effective strategy consists of creating a specific fund—a separate savings account, for example—to which a fixed amount is allocated each month. Reducing unnecessary expenses—like daily coffees or eating out—can free up a surprising amount of money over time. Considering more economical travel alternatives—such as off-season flights or accommodations with kitchens—also contributes significantly to savings. Furthermore, looking for offers and discounts in advance—especially on flights and hotels—can make a difference of up to 20% in the total cost. By following these tips, the dream of a perfect—and debt-free—vacation becomes an achievable reality.

text_es: For months, I've been dedicated to a task that requires great discipline: saving for my next vacation, a dream I've cherished for a long time. Every cent counts, so my most direct action was to start bringing lunch to work—something I never used to do. I've also drastically cut down on my weekend outings; I confess I miss the outdoor cafes. Additionally, I started selling some things online that I no longer use—clothes, books, small objects—and I'm surprised by how effective this activity is; seriously, try it. At first, it was a bit frustrating not being able to treat myself to small indulgences, but now I see the progress, and that motivates me immensely—I already have almost 50% of the budget. I know the effort will be rewarded when I'm on the beach in Santorini, my dream destination, enjoying a great time.
text_tgt_raw: Há meses que me dedico a uma tarefa que exige grande disciplina: poupar para as minhas próximas férias, um sonho que acalento há muito tempo. Cada cêntimo é importante, por isso a minha ação mais direta foi começar a levar o almoço para o trabalho – algo que nunca fazia. Também reduzi drasticamente as minhas saídas de fim de semana; confesso que sinto falta dos esplanadas. Além disso, comecei a vender online algumas coisas que já não uso – roupas, livros, pequenos objetos – e estou surpreendida com a eficácia desta atividade; a sério, experimentem. No início, era um pouco frustrante não poder mimar-me com pequenas indulgências, mas agora vejo o progresso e isso motiva-me imenso – já tenho quase 50% do orçamento. Sei que o esforço será recompensado quando estiver na praia em Santorini, o meu destino de sonho, a desfrutar de um ótimo momento.
base_en: For months now, I've been immersed in the arduous task of saving for my next vacation—a dream I've had for a long time. Every penny counts, so I've chosen to bring my lunch to work—something I never used to do—and I've drastically cut down on my weekend outings—I confess, I miss the patios. I've even started selling some things I don't use—clothes, books, various knick-knacks—online, and I'm surprised at how well it works—seriously, try it. At 1st, it was a little frustrating not being able to treat myself to small indulgences—a latte here, a dessert there—but now I see the progress and it motivates me a lot—I already have almost 50% of the budget. I know the effort will be worth it when I'm lying on the beach in Santorini—my dream destination—enjoying every moment.

text_es: To start saving for your vacation—a crucial action for your enjoyment—it's essential to establish a detailed budget. First, calculate the estimated expenses—transportation, accommodation, food, activities—to have a target amount. Then, review your monthly spending with complete honesty and identify where you can cut back: perhaps reduce restaurant outings or postpone a major purchase. Consider opening a separate savings account, exclusively for this project, and automate regular transfers, even if it's a small amount initially. Small current sacrifices, like one less coffee, can turn into great rewards tomorrow. Remember that consistency, a key factor for success, is more important than the initial amount. With discipline and some creativity, your dream vacation will be closer than you imagine.
text_tgt_raw: Para começar a poupar para as férias – uma ação crucial para o seu gozo –, é essencial estabelecer um orçamento detalhado. Primeiramente, calcule as despesas estimadas – transporte, alojamento, alimentação, atividades – para ter um valor objetivo. Depois, revise os seus gastos mensais com total sinceridade e identifique onde pode cortar: talvez reduzir as saídas a restaurantes ou adiar uma compra maior. Considere abrir uma conta poupança separada, exclusiva para este projeto, e automatize transferências regulares, mesmo que seja um valor pequeno no início. Pequenos sacrifícios atuais, como um café a menos, podem transformar-se em ótimas recompensas amanhã. Lembre-se de que a consistência, um fator chave para o sucesso, é mais importante do que o montante inicial. Com disciplina e alguma criatividade, as suas férias de sonho estarão mais próximas do que imagina.
base_en: To start saving for vacation—something crucial for enjoyment—it's essential to establish a detailed budget. 1st, calculate estimated expenses—transportation, accommodation, food, activities—to have a target figure. Afterward, review your monthly expenses—with absolute sincerity—and identify where you can cut back: perhaps reduce restaurant outings or postpone a large purchase. Consider opening a separate savings account—exclusive for this purpose—and automate regular transfers, even if it's a small amount at 1st. Small sacrifices today—one less coffee, for example—can turn into big rewards tomorrow. Remember that consistency—the key to success—is more important than the initial amount. With discipline—and a little ingenuity—your dream vacation will be closer than you imagine.

text_es: Learning a new language is an enriching and sometimes challenging experience that opens doors to new cultures and perspectives. This activity involves acquiring vocabulary, grammar, and phonetics, requiring constant and patient dedication, as well as regular practice. The benefits are great: it improves cognitive functions, such as memory and problem-solving, facilitates communication while traveling, and expands professional opportunities in an increasingly globalized world. There are various methodologies to achieve this goal, from formal classes to self-learning, with total or partial immersion in the language often being the most effective method. The key to success lies in personal and intrinsic motivation and maintaining a positive attitude towards mistakes—an inherent aspect of the process—viewing them as opportunities for learning and correction. Currently, with 15% of the world's population speaking more than one language, this is an invaluable skill.
text_tgt_raw: Aprender uma nova língua é uma experiência enriquecedora e, por vezes, desafiadora, que abre portas para novas culturas e perspetivas. Esta atividade envolve a aquisição de vocabulário, gramática e fonética, exigindo uma dedicação constante e paciente, bem como prática regular. Os benefícios são ótimos: melhora as funções cognitivas, como a memória e a resolução de problemas, facilita a comunicação em viagens e expande as oportunidades profissionais num mundo cada vez mais globalizado. Existem diversas metodologias para atingir este objetivo, desde aulas formais até à autoaprendizagem, sendo a imersão total ou parcial na língua muitas vezes o método mais efetivo. A chave para o sucesso reside na motivação pessoal e intrínseca e na manutenção de uma atitude positiva perante os erros – um aspeto inerente ao processo – encarando-os como oportunidades de aprendizagem e de correção. Atualmente, com 15% da população mundial a falar mais de uma língua, esta é uma competência de valor inestimável.
base_en: Learning a new language is an enriching and challenging experience that opens doors to new cultures and perspectives. It involves the acquisition of vocabulary, grammar, and phonetics, which requires constant and patient dedication and regular practice. The benefits are numerous: it improves cognitive functions—such as memory and problem-solving—facilitates communication while traveling, and expands professional opportunities in an increasingly globalized world. There are diverse methodologies—from formal classes to self-learning—to achieve this, and total or partial immersion in the language is often the most effective. The key to success lies in personal and intrinsic motivation and in maintaining a positive attitude toward mistakes—an inherent part of the process—considering them learning opportunities. With 15% of the world's population speaking more than 1 language, it's a valuable skill.

text_es: I vividly remember the first time I tried to learn Japanese, five years ago. It was a challenge, and in fact, it still is, because the writing system is completely different from ours. In the beginning, memorizing hiragana and katakana seemed like an almost impossible task, with their 46 basic characters each. I dedicated an hour or more a day to reviewing, using flashcards and watching anime without subtitles – a great strategy, in fact. The frustration was real, but the satisfaction of understanding a sentence, however simple, gave me the motivation to continue. Currently, after so much effort and still in the learning process, I can have basic conversations and read manga. It was an enriching experience that I recommend to everyone, a process of adopting new knowledge that brought me many accomplished goals.
text_tgt_raw: Lembro-me vivamente da primeira vez que tentei aprender japonês, há cinco anos. Foi um desafio e, na verdade, ainda o é, porque o sistema de escrita é completamente diferente do nosso. No início, memorizar o hiragana e o katakana era uma atividade que me parecia quase impossível, com os seus 46 carateres básicos cada. Dedicava uma hora ou mais por dia a rever, usando *flashcards* e vendo anime sem legendas – uma ótima estratégia, de facto. A frustração era real, mas a satisfação de compreender uma frase, por mais simples que fosse, dava-me a motivação para continuar. Atualmente, após tanto esforço e ainda em processo de aprendizagem, consigo ter conversas básicas e ler mangás. Foi uma experiência enriquecedora e que recomendo a todos, um processo de adoção de novos conhecimentos que me trouxe muitos objetivos concretizados.
base_en: I vividly remember the 1st time I tried to learn Japanese—5 years ago now. It was a challenge—it still is—because the writing system is completely different from ours. At 1st, memorizing hiragana and katakana was torture—I thought I'd never succeed—with their 46 basic characters each. Every day I dedicated 1 hour—or even more—to reviewing, using flashcards and watching anime without subtitles—a good strategy. The frustration was real, but the satisfaction of understanding a sentence—even if it was simple—drove me to continue. Now, after so much effort—and still in process—I can hold basic conversations and read manga. It has been an enriching experience—and one I recommend to everyone.

text_es: To master a new language, a rewarding activity, immersion is an essential factor. Start by surrounding yourself with the language, listening to music or podcasts—even while doing other tasks—and watching series or movies in their original version—with subtitles, initially—so that your ear gets used to the sounds and intonation. Practice daily, even if it's only 10 or 15 minutes, trying to speak from day one, without fear of making mistakes, as these are part of the learning process. Find an exchange partner or a teacher, if your budget allows, who can correct and motivate you. Don't worry too much about grammar at an early stage; fluency comes first; the goal is to communicate and understand the essentials, expanding your vocabulary with words and phrases useful for your current life, prioritizing what you will actually use. Consistency and patience are your best allies on this great journey.
text_tgt_raw: Para dominar uma nova língua, uma atividade gratificante, a imersão é um fator essencial. Comece por se rodear do idioma, ouvindo música ou podcasts — mesmo enquanto efetua outras tarefas — e assistindo a séries ou filmes na sua versão original — com legendas, inicialmente — para que o seu ouvido se acostume aos sons e à entonação. Pratique diariamente, mesmo que sejam apenas 10 ou 15 minutos, tentando falar desde o primeiro dia, sem medo de cometer erros, pois estes são parte do processo de aprendizagem. Encontre um parceiro de intercâmbio ou um professor, se o seu orçamento o permitir, que o possa corrigir e motivar. Não se preocupe excessivamente com a gramática numa fase inicial, a fluência vem primeiro; o objetivo é comunicar e compreender o essencial, expandindo o seu vocabulário com palavras e frases úteis para a sua vida atual, priorizando o que irá efetivamente usar. A consistência e a paciência são os seus melhores aliados nesta ótima jornada.

text_es: Running in a popular race – whether a marathon or a half marathon – means participating in a mass sporting event, open to athletes of all experience levels. These events, which often take place in urban environments, have predefined distances, such as 5 km, 10 km, 21 km (half marathon), or 42 km (marathon), and their main appeal, in addition to the competition, is the collective experience and festive atmosphere. Participants, from experienced athletes to beginners, prepare months in advance, following specific training plans to improve their endurance and prevent injuries. Registration usually includes a bib with a timing chip, a commemorative t-shirt, and access to support stations along the course. Finishing a popular race, especially the first one, is a great personal achievement that often promotes a more active and healthy lifestyle. Many runners, motivated by solidarity, use these activities to raise funds for charitable causes. The final reaction is a feeling of pride and accomplishment.
text_tgt_raw: Correr numa corrida popular – seja uma maratona ou meia maratona – implica participar num evento desportivo de massas, aberto a atletas de todos os níveis de experiência. Estes eventos, que ocorrem muitas vezes em ambientes urbanos, têm distâncias predefinidas, como 5 km, 10 km, 21 km (meia maratona) ou 42 km (maratona), e o seu principal atrativo, para além da competição, é a experiência coletiva e a atmosfera festiva. Os participantes, desde atletas experientes a iniciantes, preparam-se com meses de antecedência, seguindo planos de treino específicos para melhorar a sua resistência e evitar lesões. A inscrição geralmente inclui um dorsal com chip de cronometragem, uma t-shirt comemorativa e acesso a estações de apoio ao longo do percurso. Concluir uma corrida popular, especialmente a primeira, é uma ótima conquista pessoal que promove frequentemente um estilo de vida mais ativo e saudável. Muitos corredores, motivados pela solidariedade, aproveitam estas atividades para angariar fundos para causas de caridade. A reação final é um sentimento de orgulho e superação.
base_en: Running a popular race—also known as a marathon or half marathon—involves participating in a mass sporting event, open to runners of all skill levels. These events—often urban—have predefined distances, such as 5 km, 10 km, 21 km (half marathon), or 42 km (marathon), and their main appeal—beyond the competition—is the collective experience and festive atmosphere. Participants—from experienced athletes to beginners—prepare months in advance, following specific training plans to improve their endurance and avoid injuries. Registration usually includes a bib number—with a timing chip—a commemorative t-shirt, and access to aid stations along the route. Finishing a popular race—especially the 1st one—is a significant personal achievement that often promotes a more active and healthy lifestyle. Many runners—motivated by solidarity—use these events to raise funds for charitable causes.

text_es: The first time I decided to run a popular race—an experience I always wanted to have—was an unexpected challenge. I signed up three weeks before, without much preparation, just with a little daily jogging, and the truth is I underestimated the difficulty. On race day, a sunny spring Sunday, the atmosphere was electric, with people cheering everywhere. At first, everything went well, I felt the collective energy, but around kilometer 5 my legs started to fail, my calves burned. I remember thinking about giving up, I was exhausted, but seeing the other runners and the public's support gave me strength to continue. Finally, I crossed the finish line, a personal goal, exhausted, but with immense satisfaction that still stays with me today. It was a great lesson about the importance of proper preparation and an active attitude towards challenges.
text_tgt_raw: A primeira vez que decidi correr uma prova popular — uma experiência que sempre quis ter — foi um desafio inesperado. Inscrevi-me três semanas antes, sem grande preparação, apenas com um pouco de *jogging* diário, e a verdade é que subestimei a dificuldade. No dia da corrida, um domingo ensolarado de primavera, a atmosfera era elétrica, com pessoas a aplaudir por todo o lado. No início, tudo correu bem, sentia a energia coletiva, mas por volta do quilómetro 5 as minhas pernas começaram a falhar, os gémeos ardiam. Lembro-me de pensar em desistir, estava exausto, mas ver os outros corredores e o apoio do público deu-me força para continuar. Finalmente, cruzei a linha de chegada, um objetivo pessoal, exausto, mas com uma satisfação imensa que ainda hoje me acompanha. Foi uma ótima lição sobre a importância de uma preparação correta e de uma atitude ativa perante os desafios.
base_en: The 1st time I decided to run a popular race—an experience I always wanted to have—it was an unexpected challenge. I signed up 3 weeks before, without much preparation—just a little daily jogging—and the truth is I underestimated the difficulty. On race day—a sunny spring Sunday—the atmosphere was electrifying, with people cheering everywhere. At 1st everything went well—I felt the group's energy—but around km 5 my legs started to give out—my calves were burning. I remember thinking about quitting—I was exhausted—but seeing the other runners and the public's support gave me strength to continue. Finally, I crossed the finish line—a personal achievement—exhausted, but with immense satisfaction that still stays with me today.

text_es: If you are starting out in the world of popular races—an experience that can be great—it is essential to prepare correctly to enjoy it to the fullest. Start with gradual training, without haste or unnecessary pressure, progressively increasing the distance and intensity of your sessions to avoid injuries, a very common aspect if you are not careful. It is crucial to take care of your diet, essential fuel for the body, and ensure good hydration—drink water before, during, and after. Choose appropriate footwear—the investment pays off—and comfortable clothing that allows you total freedom of movement. During the race, maintain a consistent pace, without starting too fast, and pay attention to your body, without overexerting yourself. Enjoy the atmosphere and every kilometer covered, because the finish line is just the beginning of a new collection of challenges! Your dedication and responsible action will bring effective and optimal results.
text_tgt_raw: Se está a iniciar-se no mundo das corridas populares — uma experiência que pode ser ótima —, é fundamental preparar-se corretamente para desfrutá-la ao máximo. Comece com um treino gradual, sem pressas nem pressão desnecessária, aumentando progressivamente a distância e a intensidade das suas sessões para evitar lesões, um aspeto muito comum se não for cuidadoso. É crucial cuidar da sua dieta, combustível essencial para o corpo, e assegurar uma boa hidratação — beba água antes, durante e depois. Escolha o calçado adequado — o investimento compensa — e roupa confortável que lhe permita total liberdade de movimentos. Durante a corrida, mantenha um ritmo consistente, sem começar demasiado rápido, e dê atenção ao seu corpo, sem se sobrecarregar. Desfrute da atmosfera e de cada quilómetro percorrido, pois a meta é apenas o início de uma nova coleção de desafios! A sua dedicação e ação responsável trarão resultados efetivos e ótimos.

Start with gradual training—without haste or unnecessary pressure—progressively increasing the distance and intensity of your sessions to avoid injuries—something very common if you're not careful. It's crucial to take care of your diet—essential fuel for your body—and ensure good hydration—drink water before, during, and after. Choose appropriate footwear—the investment is worth it—and comfortable clothing that allows you to move freely. During the race, maintain a consistent pace—don't start too fast—and listen to your body, without overexerting yourself. Enjoy the atmosphere and every kilometer covered—the finish line is just the beginning!

text_es: The restoration of an antique piece of furniture, an activity that requires patience and deep knowledge, aims to return it to its original splendor without altering its historical essence. This process, which is an act of care and respect for the past, begins with a detailed inspection of its current condition to detect any structural damage, woodworm attacks, or finish deterioration. Next, a careful cleaning is carried out to remove layers of dirt or old varnishes, revealing the original wood. Structural repairs, such as gluing joints or replacing damaged parts, are fundamental steps to ensure the stability of the piece. Finally, a new finish is applied—which can be shellac, wax, or oil—always in line with the period and style, protecting it and enhancing its beauty. This action allows the furniture to continue telling its story for many more years, a great testament to a well-preserved past.
text_tgt_raw: A restauração de uma peça de mobiliário antiga, uma atividade que exige paciência e um conhecimento profundo, tem como objetivo devolvê-la ao seu esplendor original sem alterar a sua essência histórica. Este processo, que é um ato de carinho e respeito pelo passado, começa com uma inspeção detalhada do seu estado atual para detetar quaisquer danos estruturais, ataques de xilófagos ou deterioração do acabamento. A seguir, efetua-se uma limpeza cuidadosa para remover camadas de sujidade ou vernizes antigos, revelando a madeira original. Reparações estruturais, como a colagem de juntas ou a substituição de partes danificadas, são passos fundamentais para garantir a estabilidade da peça. Por fim, aplica-se um novo acabamento – que pode ser goma-laca, cera ou óleo – sempre em linha com a época e o estilo, protegendo-a e realçando a sua beleza. Esta ação permite que o mobiliário continue a contar a sua história por muitos mais anos, um testemunho ótimo de um passado bem preservado.
base_en: Restoring an antique piece of furniture—a meticulous and rewarding task—involves a process that seeks to return it to its original splendor without altering its historical essence. This work—which requires patience and knowledge—begins with a thorough evaluation of the piece's condition—identifying structural damage, woodworm, or deterioration in the finish. Subsequently, cleaning proceeds—removing layers of dirt or old varnishes—to reveal the original wood. Structural repairs—such as gluing joints or replacing broken parts—are fundamental to ensuring the furniture's stability. Finally, a new finish is applied—respecting the era and style—which can be shellac, wax, or oil-based, protecting it and enhancing its beauty, thus allowing the furniture—a witness to the past—to continue telling its story for many more years.

text_es: Restoring an antique piece of furniture is a rewarding project that requires attention. Start by thoroughly cleaning the surface, using products specifically for wood. Next, assess its current condition to detect damage, such as cracks or woodworm. If woodworm holes exist, injecting an anti-woodworm product is a crucial action for the furniture's longevity. Afterward, sand the wood patiently and in the direction of the grain, using progressively finer grit sandpaper. After this step, apply the final coat – wax, varnish, or paint, depending on the desired style – and let it dry completely, following the manufacturer's instructions. This renovation process offers an optimal result and the satisfaction of a job well done.
text_tgt_raw: Restaurar uma peça de mobiliário antiga é um projeto gratificante que exige atenção. Comece por limpar a superfície em profundidade, usando produtos específicos para madeira. De seguida, avalie o seu estado atual para detetar danos, como rachaduras ou caruncho. Se existirem orifícios de caruncho, a injeção de um produto anti-caruncho é uma ação crucial para a longevidade do móvel. Posteriormente, lixe a madeira pacientemente e na direção do veio, utilizando lixas de grão progressivamente mais fino. Após este passo, aplique a camada final – cera, verniz ou tinta, dependendo do estilo desejado – e deixe secar completamente, seguindo as instruções do fabricante. Este processo de renovação oferece um resultado ótimo e a satisfação de um trabalho bem executado.
base_en: To restore an antique piece of furniture—a rewarding project—start by thoroughly cleaning the surface—use specific wood products. Then, assess the condition of the piece—identify damage such as cracks or woodworm. If there are woodworm holes, inject an anti-woodworm product—it's vital for the furniture's longevity. Afterward, sand the wood patiently and in the direction of the grain—use progressively finer grit sandpaper. Once ready, apply the final coat—wax, varnish, or paint, depending on the desired style—and let it dry completely—follow the manufacturer's instructions. You'll enjoy the process and your renewed piece!

text_es: Organizing a birthday party, an event many consider great, requires careful planning and attention to multiple details. Initially, setting the date and time is a crucial factor to ensure guests' presence, and the number of participants should be defined about three to four weeks in advance for sending invitations. The selection of the venue, whether at home or a rented space, is another fundamental aspect that will directly depend on the available budget. Additionally, one needs to decide on the theme, if there is one, the decoration, the menu—including the cake, of course—and the drinks. We cannot forget the music, an essential element for the atmosphere, and, if desired, activities or games to entertain those present, with the goal that everyone enjoys the celebration to the fullest.
text_tgt_raw: Organizar uma festa de aniversário, um evento que muitos consideram ótimo, exige uma cuidadosa planificação e atenção a múltiplos detalhes. Inicialmente, a fixação da data e hora é um fator crucial para garantir a presença dos convidados, e o número de participantes deve ser definido com cerca de três a quatro semanas de antecedência para o envio dos convites. A seleção do local, seja em casa ou num espaço alugado, é outro aspeto fundamental que dependerá diretamente do orçamento disponível. Adicionalmente, é preciso decidir o tema, se houver um, a decoração, o menu — incluindo o bolo, claro — e as bebidas. Não podemos esquecer a música, um elemento essencial para a atmosfera, e, se desejado, atividades ou jogos para entreter os presentes, com o objetivo de que todos desfrutem ao máximo da celebração.
base_en: Organizing a birthday party—a memorable event for many—requires planning and attention to detail. Initially, the date and time must be set—crucial factors for attendance—and the number of guests decided—ideally, 3, or 4 weeks in advance to send out invitations. The choice of venue—whether at home or a rented space—is another fundamental step that will depend on the available budget—an aspect to consider seriously. Additionally, the theme—if there's one—and the decoration must be defined, as well as the menu—including the cake, of course—and the drinks. Don't forget the music—a key element for the atmosphere—and, if desired, activities, or games to entertain attendees, ensuring everyone enjoys themselves to the fullest—the main goal of the celebration.

text_es: Organizing my sister's 10th birthday party was an unexpected but very rewarding adventure. I started with the guest list, a total of fifteen children, and then dedicated myself to selecting the decorations. I bought colorful balloons, both helium and regular, and garlands, with the goal of creating a festive and welcoming atmosphere. The biggest complication was the cake, as she wanted a three-tier cake, which required me to order it two weeks in advance. On the day of the party, a sunny Saturday, everything went great. There were many games, laughter, and the food, with pizzas, sandwiches, and lots of sweets, was a total success. Seeing the happy expression on my sister's face and her smile made all the effort for this project worthwhile, a true display of affection. Her reaction was the greatest reward.
text_tgt_raw: Organizar a festa do 10º aniversário da minha irmã foi uma aventura inesperada, mas muito gratificante. Comecei com a lista de convidados, um total de quinze crianças, e depois dediquei-me à seleção das decorações. Comprei balões coloridos, tanto de hélio como normais, e grinaldas, com o objetivo de criar um ambiente festivo e acolhedor. A maior complicação foi o bolo, pois ela queria um bolo de três andares, o que exigiu que o encomendasse com duas semanas de antecedência. No dia da festa, um sábado ensolarado, tudo correu de forma ótima. Houve muitos jogos, gargalhadas e a comida, com pizzas, sandes e muitos doces, foi um sucesso total. Ver a expressão de felicidade no rosto da minha irmã e o seu sorriso fez com que todo o esforço para este projeto valesse a pena, uma verdadeira demonstração de afeto. A reação dela foi o maior prémio.
base_en: Organizing my sister's 10th birthday party—she was turning 10—was an unexpected adventure. I started with a guest list—a total of 15 children—and then I dedicated myself to the decorations. I bought colorful balloons—many, helium, and regular—and garlands. The biggest complication was the cake—she wanted a 3-tier cake—since I had to order it 2 weeks in advance. On the day of the party—a sunny Saturday—everything went perfectly. There were games, laughter, and the food—pizzas, sandwiches, and many sweets—was a total success. Seeing my sister's happy face—her smile was worth all the effort—made every detail worthwhile.

text_es: To organize a truly memorable birthday party, it's great to start two to three weeks in advance, ensuring every detail is taken care of. The first step and determining factor is to establish the budget and the number of guests, as these aspects will guide all subsequent choices. Next, select the venue – whether at home, a rented space, or outdoors – and the most convenient date and time for the majority. Don't forget to define a theme, if desired, and plan a delicious menu with options for everyone, including drinks. An essential action is to send out invitations in a timely manner, allowing guests to confirm their attendance. Finally, prepare a list of activities and games, especially if there are children. With such straightforward planning, the result will be a fantastic celebration, allowing you to fully enjoy the day, after all the work.
text_tgt_raw: Para organizar uma festa de aniversário verdadeiramente memorável, é ótimo começar com duas a três semanas de antecedência, garantindo que cada detalhe seja cuidado. O primeiro passo e fator determinante é estabelecer o orçamento e o número de convidados, pois estes aspetos direcionarão todas as escolhas subsequentes. De seguida, selecione o local – seja em casa, um espaço alugado ou ao ar livre – e a data e hora mais convenientes para a maioria. Não se esqueça de definir um tema, se desejar, e de planear um menu delicioso com opções para todos, incluindo bebidas. Uma ação essencial é enviar os convites atempadamente, permitindo que os convidados confirmem a sua presença. Finalmente, prepare uma lista de atividades e jogos, especialmente se houver crianças. Com um planeamento tão direto, o resultado será uma celebração fantástica, permitindo-lhe desfrutar plenamente do dia, após todo o trabalho.
base_en: To organize a birthday party—a memorable event—it's crucial to start 2 or 3 weeks in advance. 1st, define the budget—the basis of everything—and the number of guests—a key factor. Then, choose the venue—at home, a rented place, or outdoors—and the date and time—considering the availability of most. Don't forget the theme—if you want one—the food—think of options for everyone—and the drinks. Send out invitations in advance—so they can confirm attendance—and prepare a list of activities or games—especially if there are children. Finally, relax, and enjoy the day—after so much work.

text_es: I've always been a bit clumsy with gardening, but since I moved into my new apartment, with more light, fortunately, I've discovered the joy of caring for houseplants. I started with a pothos, which is quite resilient, and little by little my small balcony filled with green. It's incredible how such a simple activity – watering, pruning, and fertilizing now and then – can bring so much calm and satisfaction. Every morning, the first thing I do, even before coffee, is check on my "little ones." I've noticed that the atmosphere of my home, previously a bit bland, has greatly improved with them; even the air seems, subjectively, of course, fresher. Currently, I already have seven plants and I'm thinking of adopting a few more, perhaps a fiddle-leaf fig. My goal is to create a small green oasis, and this daily action has become a great habit.
text_tgt_raw: Sempre fui um pouco desajeitado com jardinagem, mas desde que me mudei para o meu novo apartamento, com mais luz, felizmente, descobri o prazer de cuidar de plantas de interior. Comecei com um pothos, que é bastante resiliente, e pouco a pouco a minha pequena varanda encheu-se de verde. É incrível como uma atividade tão simples – regar, podar e fertilizar de vez em quando – pode trazer tanta calma e satisfação. Todas as manhãs, a primeira coisa que faço, mesmo antes do café, é verificar como estão os meus "pequeninos". Tenho notado que a atmosfera da minha casa, antes um pouco insípida, melhorou muito com eles; até o ar parece, de forma subjetiva, claro, mais fresco. Atualmente, já tenho sete plantas e estou a pensar em adotar mais algumas, talvez uma figueira-lira. O meu objetivo é criar um pequeno oásis verde, e esta ação diária tornou-se um ótimo hábito.

I started with a pothos—quite resilient, actually—and little by little my small balcony has filled with green. It's incredible how something so simple—watering, pruning, and fertilizing now and then—can bring so much calm and satisfaction. Every morning, the 1st thing I do—even before coffee—is check on my little ones. I've noticed that the atmosphere of my home—previously a bit bland—has improved a lot with them; even the air feels—subjectively, of course—fresher. Now I already have 7 plants and I'm thinking of adding a couple more—a fiddle-leaf fig, perhaps.

text_es: To begin caring for your indoor plants, a rewarding activity, it's essential to know their specific needs. Make sure to research the amount of light each species requires – direct or indirect – to place them in the optimal spot in your home. Watering is a crucial factor – neither too much nor too little: always check the soil moisture with your finger before adding more water and only water when the top 2 or 3 cm are dry. It's equally important to choose pots with good drainage, with holes in the bottom, to prevent waterlogging, which is one of the main causes of death. Pay attention to environmental humidity, especially in winter, and periodic fertilization, every 2 or 3 months, to promote active and healthy growth. Finally, pay attention to possible pests, such as mites, and intervene quickly to protect the health of your plants, a preventive action that will ensure their well-being.
text_tgt_raw: Para iniciar a cuidar das suas plantas de interior, uma atividade gratificante, é fundamental conhecer as suas necessidades específicas. Certifique-se de pesquisar a quantidade de luz que cada espécie exige – direta ou indireta – para as colocar no local ótimo da sua casa. A rega é um fator crucial – nem em excesso nem em falta: verifique sempre a humidade do solo com o dedo antes de adicionar mais água e regue apenas quando os primeiros 2 ou 3 cm estiverem secos. É igualmente importante escolher vasos com boa drenagem, com furos no fundo, para evitar o encharcamento, que é uma das principais causas de morte. Tenha em atenção a humidade ambiental, especialmente no inverno, e a fertilização periódica, a cada 2 ou 3 meses, para promover um crescimento ativo e saudável. Por fim, preste atenção a possíveis pragas, como os ácaros, e intervenha rapidamente para proteger a saúde das suas plantas, uma ação preventiva que garantirá o seu bem-estar.
base_en: To start caring for your indoor plants—a rewarding task—it's essential to know their specific needs. Make sure to research the amount of light each species requires—direct or indirect—to place them in the right spot in your home. Watering is crucial—neither too much nor too little: always check the soil's moisture with your finger before adding more water and only water when the 1st 2 or 3 cm are dry. It's also important to choose pots with good drainage—with holes in the bottom—to prevent waterlogging, which is one of the main causes of death. Consider ambient humidity—especially in winter—and periodic fertilization—every 2 or 3 months—to encourage healthy growth. Finally, pay attention to possible pests—like spider mites—and intervene quickly to protect the health of your plants.

text_es: Choosing a suitable mattress is fundamental for ensuring restorative sleep and optimal posture, a crucial aspect for spinal health. Currently, the market offers a wide range of options, from traditional spring mattresses to viscoelastic foam ones, each with characteristics that adapt to diverse needs and preferences. It is imperative to consider the firmness level—neither too soft nor excessively rigid—the material, which should be breathable, and the dimensions, correct for the bed and for the person who will be sleeping. Additionally, factors such as the user's body weight, whether the person sleeps alone or with a partner, and their usual sleeping position directly influence the final decision. Trying out the mattress for a few minutes, and in different positions, is an essential act before making the purchase, to ensure a correct selection. Investing in a quality mattress, although it may seem like a high initial cost, is a project for long-term well-being protection.
text_tgt_raw: A escolha de um colchão adequado é fundamental para garantir um sono reparador e uma postura ótima, um aspeto crucial para a saúde da coluna. Atualmente, o mercado oferece uma vasta gama de opções, desde os tradicionais de molas até aos de espuma viscoelástica, cada um com caraterísticas que se adaptam a necessidades e preferências diversas. É imperativo considerar o nível de firmeza – nem demasiado mole nem excessivamente rígido –, o material, que deve ser respirável, e as dimensões, corretas para a cama e para quem vai dormir. Adicionalmente, fatores como o peso corporal do utilizador, se a pessoa dorme sozinha ou acompanhada, e a sua posição habitual de sono influenciam diretamente a decisão final. Experimentar o colchão por alguns minutos, e em diferentes posições, é um ato essencial antes de efetuar a compra, para assegurar uma seleção acertada. Investir num colchão de qualidade, embora possa parecer um custo inicial elevado, é um projeto de proteção do bem-estar a longo prazo.
base_en: Choosing a good mattress is essential to ensure restful sleep and good postural health—a crucial aspect for the back. There are various types of mattresses on the market—from springs to memory foam—each with particular characteristics that adapt to different needs and preferences. It's important to consider the level of firmness—neither too soft nor excessively hard—the material—which should be breathable—and the size—appropriate for the dimensions of the bed and the sleeper. In addition, factors such as the user's body weight—a detail often underestimated—whether one sleeps alone or with a partner, and the usual sleeping posture—on one's back, side, or stomach—significantly influence the final decision. Trying the mattress for a few minutes—even in different positions—is indispensable before making the purchase to ensure a correct choice. Investing in a quality mattress—although it may seem like a high expense initially—is an investment in long-term well-being.

text_es: The decision to choose a mattress—which seemed like such a simple action—turned into a real odyssey. After 15 years with the same one, I felt it was time to upgrade and didn't imagine the vast collection of options that awaited me. I visited about five specialized stores, some with overly active salespeople, and spent hours reading online reviews, which, frankly, only increased my confusion. In the end, I adopted a memory foam mattress, or at least that's what they promised me. After three nights of testing, which were a decisive factor, its firmness and adaptability proved to be excellent. Currently, I sleep like a baby, a truly correct experience, and I don't regret the investment.
text_tgt_raw: A decisão de escolher um colchão — que parecia ser uma ação tão simples — transformou-se numa verdadeira odisseia. Após 15 anos com o mesmo, senti que era o momento de atualizar e não imaginava a vasta coleção de opções que me esperava. Visitei cerca de cinco lojas especializadas, algumas com vendedores excessivamente ativos, e perdi horas a ler avaliações online, o que, francamente, só aumentou a minha confusão. No final, adotei um colchão de espuma viscoelástica, ou pelo menos foi o que me prometeram. Após três noites de testes, que foram um fator decisivo, a sua firmeza e adaptabilidade provaram ser ótimas. Atualmente, durmo como um bebé, uma experiência verdadeiramente correta, e não me arrependo do investimento.
base_en: The decision to choose a mattress—and it seems so simple—became an unexpected odyssey for me. After 15 years using the same one, I decided it was time for a change, but I didn't know the number of options—hundreds!—that awaited me. I visited at least 5 specialized stores—some with very insistent salespeople—and spent hours reading reviews online, which only increased my confusion. In the end, I opted for a memory foam one—or so they promised me—which, after 3 nights of testing—a decisive factor—convinced me with its firmness and adaptability. Now, finally, I sleep like a baby—the truth is it's wonderful—and I don't regret the investment.

text_es: When selecting a mattress, an action of great importance for your rest, it's great to start by considering the firmness that best suits your sleeping posture. If you primarily sleep on your back, a medium-firm mattress may be the most suitable, offering the necessary support without excessive rigidity. For those who sleep on their side, and with the goal of avoiding pressure points on the shoulders and hips, a softer and more adaptable mattress, such as memory foam, is currently the best option. Don't forget to test the mattress in the store for at least 10 to 15 minutes – going beyond simply sitting is essential to ensure it's truly comfortable for you. Also check the materials, a crucial factor for those who suffer from allergies or sensitivities, and the warranties offered by manufacturers, which are an indicator of quality and protection. A good mattress is an asset that can last between 8 to 10 years, therefore being a long-term investment; so, take the necessary time to make a thoughtful choice.
text_tgt_raw: Ao selecionar um colchão, uma ação de grande importância para o seu descanso, é ótimo começar por considerar a firmeza que melhor se adapta à sua postura ao dormir. Se o seu sono é primordialmente de costas, um colchão de firmeza média pode ser o mais correto, oferecendo o suporte necessário sem rigidez excessiva. Para quem dorme de lado, e com o objetivo de evitar pontos de pressão nos ombros e ancas, um colchão mais suave e adaptável, como os de espuma de memória, é atualmente a melhor opção. Não se esqueça de testar o colchão na loja durante pelo menos 10 a 15 minutos – ir além de um simples sentar é essencial para ter a certeza de que é realmente confortável para si. Verifique também os materiais, um fator crucial para quem sofre de alergias ou sensibilidades, e as garantias oferecidas pelos fabricantes, que são um indicador de qualidade e proteção. Um bom colchão é um ativo que pode durar entre 8 a 10 anos, sendo, portanto, um investimento a longo prazo; por isso, reserve o tempo necessário para fazer uma escolha ponderada.
base_en: When choosing a mattress—an important decision for your rest—consider 1st the type of firmness that best suits your sleeping posture. If you sleep on your back—the most common position—a medium-firm mattress could be ideal, offering support without excessive rigidity. For those who sleep on their side—thus avoiding pressure on shoulders and hips—a softer, more adaptable mattress, like a memory foam one, is often the best option. Don't forget to try the mattress in the store for at least 10 or 15 minutes—don't just sit on it—to make sure it's really comfortable for you. Also check the materials—important for allergies or sensitivities—and the warranties offered by manufacturers—an indicator of quality. A good mattress can last between 8 and 10 years—a long-term investment—so take your time to choose well.

text_es: Reducing food waste, a global problem of great magnitude, is crucial for the planet's sustainability and food security. It is estimated that one-third of all food produced annually is lost or wasted—about 1.3 billion tons—which has serious economic, social, and environmental implications. Combating this problem involves adopting more conscious consumption habits, such as planning purchases and using leftovers, correctly storing food to extend its shelf life, thus preventing its premature spoilage, and an accurate understanding of expiration and best-by dates. The role of the food industry, from production to distribution, is also fundamental in optimizing its processes and minimizing losses, as are public policies that encourage the donation of food fit for consumption. Every small individual action, such as not discarding food in good condition, contributes to a positive collective impact, promoting a future with more environmental protection. This must always be our direction.
text_tgt_raw: A redução do desperdício alimentar, um problema global de grande magnitude, é crucial para a sustentabilidade do planeta e a segurança alimentar. Estima-se que um terço de todos os alimentos produzidos anualmente seja perdido ou desperdiçado — cerca de 1,3 mil milhões de toneladas —, o que tem implicações económicas, sociais e ambientais sérias. Combater este problema envolve a adoção de hábitos de consumo mais conscientes, como planear as compras e utilizar os excedentes, o armazenamento correto dos alimentos para prolongar a sua vida útil, evitando assim a sua deterioração prematura, e uma compreensão exata das datas de validade e de consumo preferencial. O papel da indústria alimentar, desde a produção à distribuição, é também fundamental na otimização dos seus processos e na minimização das perdas, assim como as políticas públicas que incentivam a doação de alimentos aptos para consumo. Cada pequena ação individual, como não descartar comida em boas condições, contribui para um impacto coletivo positivo, promovendo um futuro com mais proteção ambiental. A nossa direção deve ser sempre esta.
base_en: Reducing food waste—a global problem of great magnitude—is crucial for the planet's sustainability and food security. It's estimated that 1/3 of all food produced annually is lost or wasted—approximately 1.3 billion tons—which has serious economic, social, and environmental implications. Combating this involves adopting more conscious consumption habits—such as planning purchases and utilizing surpluses—properly storing food to extend its shelf life—thus preventing its premature spoilage—and thoroughly understanding expiration and best-by dates. The role of the food industry—from production to distribution—is also fundamental in optimizing its processes and minimizing losses, as are public policies that encourage the donation of food suitable for consumption. Every small individual gesture—like not discarding food in good condition—contributes to a positive collective impact.

text_es: Ever since I became more aware—several years ago—of the environmental impact of our actions, reducing food waste has become a priority in my home. I remember one time I hosted a dinner for eight friends—which is always a culinary challenge—and ended up with three days' worth of leftovers, an act that made me feel terrible. From then on, I started planning menus in advance—and with much more precision—and buying only what was necessary, avoiding impulse purchases, which are my downfall, I confess. I also adopted the habit of creatively reusing leftovers—a simple stew can turn into croquettes the next day—and the truth is, I discovered a talent for resourceful cooking that I think is great. I firmly believe that small changes in our daily habits—however insignificant they may seem—can have a real impact. Nowadays, when I see leftover food, I think: "How can I give this a second life?"—a question I like to address.
text_tgt_raw: Desde que me tornei mais consciente — há já alguns anos — do impacto ambiental das nossas ações, reduzir o desperdício alimentar tornou-se uma prioridade em minha casa. Lembro-me de uma vez que organizei um jantar para oito amigos — o que é sempre um desafio culinário — e acabei com sobras para três dias, um ato que me fez sentir terrivelmente. A partir daí, comecei a planear os menus com antecedência — e com muito mais precisão — e a comprar apenas o necessário, evitando as compras por impulso, que são a minha perdição, confesso. Adotei também o hábito de reutilizar as sobras de forma criativa — um simples cozido pode transformar-se em croquetes no dia seguinte —, e a verdade é que descobri um talento para a culinária de aproveitamento que considero ótimo. Acredito firmemente que pequenas alterações nos nossos hábitos diários — por mais insignificantes que pareçam — podem ter um impacto efetivo. Atualmente, quando vejo que há comida a sobrar, penso: "Como posso dar a isto uma segunda vida?" — uma questão a que gosto de dar uma direção.
