Make sure your home is prepared, eliminating potential hazards and establishing a space of their own for your new friend, while considering veterinary and food costs. Think about early socialization, as it's crucial for good future behavior, among other important aspects like basic training. It's essential that the entire family agrees and commits to the responsibility, while everyone understands that adaptation requires patience. Amid the excitement, don't forget the importance of continuous education, both for you and for the dog, while you learn from each other. Find a trusted veterinarian among the professionals in your area for initial and future check-ups, and consider pet insurance.

text_es: Last Saturday, I embarked on the adventure of assembling a new bookshelf for the living room, an activity I always postpone while searching for the optimal moment. Upon opening the box, I was faced with 15 wooden pieces and an instruction manual that seemed written in hieroglyphs, while my dog watched me with curiosity. There was a moment of despair before so many screws, but I took a direction and decided to follow the pictures, even if the execution wasn't exact, and individual and collective effort, should someone help me, would be essential. The truth is that, between the neighbors' noises and my own inexperience, the act of assembly was slower than expected, as I tried to adjust each part. Finally, after almost 3 hours, the bookshelf was standing, perhaps a little crooked, but functional, and a sense of pride overcame me, a successful project despite the less perfect aspects.
text_tgt_raw: No sábado passado, embarquei na aventura de montar uma nova estante para a sala, uma atividade que adio sempre enquanto procuro o momento ótimo. Ao abrir a caixa, deparei-me com 15 peças de madeira e um manual de instruções que parecia escrito em hieróglifos, enquanto o meu cão me observava com curiosidade. Houve um momento de desespero perante tantos parafusos, mas tomei uma direção e decidi seguir as imagens, mesmo que a execução não fosse exata, e o esforço individual e coletivo, caso alguém me ajudasse, seria essencial. A verdade é que, entre os ruídos dos vizinhos e a minha própria inexperiência, o ato de montagem foi mais lento do que o previsto, enquanto eu tentava ajustar cada parte. Finalmente, após quase 3 horas, a estante estava de pé, talvez um pouco torta, mas funcional, e uma sensação de orgulho tomou conta de mim, um projeto bem-sucedido apesar dos aspetos menos perfeitos.
base_en: Last Saturday, I embarked on the adventure of assembling a new bookshelf for the living room, a task I always postpone while I look for the perfect moment. Upon opening the box, I found 15 wooden pieces and an instruction manual that seemed written in hieroglyphics, while my dog watched me with curiosity. There was a moment of despair amid so many boards and screws, but I took a deep breath and decided to follow the pictures, while a friend called me on the phone to ask how I was doing. The truth is that, between the neighbors' noises and my own inexperience, the process was slower than expected, while I tried to fit each piece. Finally, after almost 3 hours, the bookshelf was standing, a little crooked perhaps, but functional, and a feeling of pride washed over me amid my small chaos.

text_es: To assemble a bookshelf efficiently, it's great to start by carefully reading the instructions, identifying all the parts and assembly hardware. Make sure you have the correct tools on hand—screwdrivers, hammer, and level—following the assembly order suggested by the manufacturer. It's practical to separate screws and hardware into different compartments of a box, which will simplify their selection when you need them. Ask someone for help if the bookshelf is large or heavy, as it can be difficult to maintain stability when handling long panels. Check that all joints are firm, confirming with the level that the structure is perfectly straight, thus avoiding future instability for the objects you place on it. Don't rush; dedicate the necessary time to each step, and your assembly project will be a success, providing a functional and long-lasting bookshelf.
text_tgt_raw: Para montar uma estante de forma eficiente, é ótimo começar por ler atentamente as instruções, identificando todas as peças e o material de montagem. Certifique-se de ter as ferramentas corretas à mão — chaves de fendas, martelo e nível —, seguindo a ordem de montagem sugerida pelo fabricante. É um ato prático separar parafusos e ferragens em diferentes compartimentos de uma caixa, o que simplificará a sua seleção quando precisar deles. Peça ajuda a alguém se a estante for grande ou pesada, pois pode ser difícil manter a estabilidade ao manusear painéis longos. Verifique que todas as juntas estão firmes, confirmando com o nível que a estrutura está perfeitamente direita, evitando assim futuras instabilidades nos objetos que colocar. Não se apresse; dedique o tempo necessário a cada etapa, e o seu projeto de montagem será um sucesso, proporcionando uma estante funcional e de longa duração.
base_en: To efficiently assemble a shelf unit, it's crucial to start by carefully reading the instructions, while identifying all the parts and hardware. Make sure you've the right tools on hand—screwdrivers, hammer, and level—while following the assembly order suggested by the manufacturer. It's very useful to sort screws and fittings into the different compartments of a box, which will simplify the process as you need them. Ask someone for help if the shelf unit is large or heavy, as it can be difficult to maintain stability while handling long panels. Check that all joints are firm, while verifying with the level that the structure is perfectly straight, thus avoiding future instabilities among the objects you place. Don't rush, take your time with each step, and you'll enjoy your new, well-assembled shelf unit.

text_es: Saving for vacation is essential to enjoy a well-deserved rest without financial worries, while every aspect of the trip is planned. This action consists of allocating a regular portion of income to a specific fund, among other financial strategies. It is advisable to establish a clear budget, amidst daily expenses, that considers transportation, accommodation, food, and activities, seeking to reduce unnecessary spending. Methods such as the 50/30/20 rule can be applied, where 20% of income is dedicated to savings, while other commitments are managed. Additionally, it is useful to compare prices and offers, among the various available options, to optimize money. It is important to be consistent and disciplined, amidst the temptations to spend, to achieve the desired goal and fully enjoy the experience.
text_tgt_raw: Poupar para as férias é essencial para desfrutar de um merecido descanso sem preocupações financeiras, enquanto cada aspeto da viagem é planeado. Esta ação consiste em alocar uma porção regular do rendimento para um fundo específico, entre outras estratégias financeiras. É aconselhável estabelecer um orçamento claro, em meio às despesas diárias, que considere transporte, alojamento, alimentação e atividades, procurando reduzir gastos desnecessários. Métodos como a regra 50/30/20 podem ser aplicados, onde 20% do rendimento é dedicado a poupanças, enquanto outros compromissos são geridos. Além disso, é útil comparar preços e ofertas, entre as várias opções disponíveis, para otimizar o dinheiro. É importante ser consistente e disciplinado, em meio às tentações de gastar, para alcançar o objetivo desejado e desfrutar plenamente da experiência.
base_en: Saving for vacation is essential to enjoy a well-deserved rest without financial worries, while every detail of the trip is planned. It consists of allocating a regular portion of income to a specific fund, among other financial strategies. It's advisable to establish a clear budget, amid daily expenses, that considers transportation, accommodation, food, and activities, while seeking to reduce unnecessary expenses. Methods such as the 50/30/20 rule can be applied, where 20% of income is dedicated to savings, while other commitments are managed. In addition, it's useful to compare prices and offers, among the various available options, to optimize money. It's important to be consistent and disciplined, amid the temptations to spend, to achieve the desired goal and fully enjoy the experience.

text_es: Last year, I made the decision to travel to Japan, and, although the idea seemed a little crazy initially, I started saving immediately. Monthly, upon receiving my salary, I deposited a fixed percentage into a separate account, an action that few of my colleagues replicated. Amidst the daily work routine, it was easy to lose sight of the goal, but the image of temples and gastronomy, while my friends went out to parties, kept me going. It was a challenge, but, as I watched the amount grow, my excitement increased, and, through sacrifices and small renunciations, I managed to gather the necessary money. Currently, as I write this, I am three days away from my flight, immersed in the anticipation of what awaits me, and I can state that the effort was great and paid off in every aspect. The direction I took proved to be the right one.
text_tgt_raw: No ano passado, tomei a decisão de viajar para o Japão, e, embora a ideia parecesse um pouco louca inicialmente, comecei a poupar imediatamente. Mensalmente, ao receber o meu salário, depositava uma percentagem fixa numa conta separada, uma ação que, entre os meus colegas, poucos replicavam. No meio da rotina de trabalho diária, era fácil perder de vista o objetivo, mas a imagem dos templos e da gastronomia, enquanto os meus amigos saíam para festas, mantinha-me ativo. Foi um desafio, mas, à medida que via o montante crescer, a minha excitação aumentava, e, entre sacrifícios e pequenas renúncias, consegui reunir o dinheiro necessário. Atualmente, enquanto redijo isto, estou a três dias do meu voo, imersa na expectativa do que me espera, e posso afirmar que o esforço foi ótimo e compensou cada aspeto. A direção que tomei revelou-se a correta.
base_en: Last year, I decided I wanted to go to Japan, and, while the idea seemed crazy at 1st, I started saving immediately. Every month, while I received my salary, I put a fixed percentage into a separate account, something that, among my colleagues, few did. Amid the daily work routine, it was easy to forget the goal, but the thought of the temples and the food, while my friends were out partying, kept me motivated. It was a challenge, but, while I watched the amount grow, my excitement increased, and, among sacrifices and small renunciations, I managed to gather the money. Now, while I'm writing this, I'm 3 days away from my flight, amid the excitement of what awaits me, and I can say that the effort was worth it.

text_es: To save for vacation, it's crucial to establish a clear budget, monitoring monthly expenses. Prioritize allocating a fixed amount each month, even if it's small, as consistent saving is a fundamental factor between your income and your expenses. Consider opening a separate savings account for this goal, which will help you avoid the temptation to use that money for other activities, seeking ways to reduce unnecessary costs in your current life. You can, for example, limit eating out or look for deals on services, while planning ahead to find better prices on flights and accommodation. Saving, among your daily responsibilities, may seem complicated, but with discipline and a few adjustments, you will see your savings grow, and your well-deserved rest approach. It's a great action for your future well-being.
text_tgt_raw: Para poupar para as férias, é crucial estabelecer um orçamento claro, monitorizando as despesas mensais. Priorize a alocação de um montante fixo a cada mês, mesmo que seja pequeno, pois a poupança consistente é um fator fundamental entre o seu rendimento e as suas despesas. Considere abrir uma conta poupança separada para esse objetivo, o que o ajudará a evitar a tentação de usar esse dinheiro para outras atividades, procurando formas de reduzir custos desnecessários na sua vida atual. Pode, por exemplo, limitar as refeições fora ou procurar ofertas em serviços, enquanto planeia com antecedência para encontrar melhores preços em voos e alojamento. Poupar, entre as suas responsabilidades diárias, pode parecer complicado, mas com disciplina e alguns ajustes, verá as suas poupanças crescerem, e o seu merecido descanso aproximar-se. É uma ótima ação para o seu bem-estar futuro.
base_en: To save for vacation, it's crucial to establish a clear budget, while monitoring your monthly expenses. Prioritize allocating a fixed amount each month, even if it's small, as consistent saving among your income and expenses is fundamental. Consider opening a separate savings account for that purpose, which will help you avoid the temptation to use that money for other things, while looking for ways to reduce unnecessary costs in your daily life. You can, for example, limit eating out or look for deals on services, while planning ahead to find better prices on flights and accommodation. Saving amid your daily responsibilities may seem complicated, but with discipline and adjustments, you'll see your savings grow, while your well-deserved rest approaches.

text_es: Learning a new language is an enriching activity that opens doors to other cultures, allowing us to communicate with more people. It is a process that requires dedication and patience, but with perseverance, it overcomes challenges. As we develop new linguistic skills, we also train our minds, improving cognitive agility and problem-solving ability, among other aspects. There are great methods to achieve this goal, from intensive courses to self-study, with total immersion in the language's country of origin often considered the most effective option. Maintaining motivation is crucial, especially in the most difficult phases, between frustration and slow progress. The more you practice, the more natural it becomes, transforming the unknown into the familiar, and this action leads to more direct and fluid communication.
text_tgt_raw: Aprender uma nova língua é uma atividade enriquecedora que abre portas para outras culturas, permitindo-nos comunicar com mais pessoas. É um processo que exige dedicação e paciência, mas que, com perseverança, supera os desafios. Enquanto desenvolvemos novas habilidades linguísticas, também treinamos a nossa mente, melhorando a agilidade cognitiva e a capacidade de resolução de problemas, entre outros aspetos. Existem ótimos métodos para atingir este objetivo, desde cursos intensivos a autoestudo, sendo a imersão total no país de origem da língua muitas vezes considerada a opção mais eficaz. Manter a motivação é crucial, especialmente nas fases mais difíceis, entre a frustração e o progresso lento. Quanto mais se pratica, mais natural se torna, transformando o desconhecido no familiar, e essa ação leva a uma comunicação mais direta e fluida.
base_en: Learning a new language is an enriching experience that opens doors to other cultures, while allowing us to communicate with more people. It's a process that demands dedication and patience, amid constant challenges that, with perseverance, are overcome. While we develop new linguistic skills, we also train our mind, improving cognitive agility and problem-solving ability, among other benefits. Many methods exist to achieve this—from intensive courses to self-taught learning—while total immersion in the language's country of origin is considered by many the most effective way. Maintaining motivation is crucial, especially amid the most difficult phases, between frustration and slow progress. The more one practices, the more natural it becomes, transforming the unknown into the familiar.

text_es: I vividly remember when I started learning Japanese, five years ago, and it was an experience that changed my perspective. I enrolled in classes while working full-time, which presented a considerable logistical challenge. Between grammar books and dictionaries, I discovered a fascinating culture; as hiragana and katakana characters mingled in my mind, I felt like a child. The pronunciation, between the soft consonants and short vowels, seemed strange to me at first. There were days, while trying to form complex sentences, when the frustration was palpable. However, amidst the difficulty, the satisfaction of understanding a new word or constructing a correct sentence was immense; while others became discouraged, I persisted, because the reward of understanding was my motivating factor. My goal was clear and with each small success I felt a great sense of accomplishment, which drove me to continue this challenging activity.
text_tgt_raw: Lembro-me vivamente de quando comecei a aprender japonês, há cinco anos, e foi uma experiência que mudou a minha perspetiva. Inscrevi-me nas aulas enquanto trabalhava a tempo inteiro, o que representou um desafio logístico considerável. Entre livros de gramática e dicionários, descobri uma cultura fascinante; enquanto os caracteres hiragana e katakana se misturavam na minha mente, sentia-me como uma criança. A pronúncia, entre as consoantes suaves e as vogais curtas, parecia-me estranha no início. Havia dias, enquanto tentava formar frases complexas, em que a frustração era palpável. No entanto, em meio à dificuldade, a satisfação de compreender uma palavra nova ou de construir uma frase correta era imensa; enquanto outros desanimavam, eu persistia, porque a recompensa da compreensão era o meu fator motivador. O meu objetivo era claro e a cada pequeno sucesso sentia uma ótima realização, o que me impulsionava a continuar esta atividade desafiadora.
base_en: I vividly remember when I started learning Japanese 5 years ago, and it was an experience that changed my perspective. I signed up for classes while working full-time, which was a significant logistical challenge. Amid grammar books and dictionaries, I discovered a fascinating culture; while hiragana and katakana characters mixed in my mind, I felt like a child. The pronunciation, among the soft consonants and short vowels, felt strange to me at 1st. There were days, while I was trying to form complex sentences, when the frustration was palpable. However, amid the difficulty, the satisfaction of understanding a new word or constructing a correct sentence was immense; while others became discouraged, I persisted, because the reward of understanding was my driving force.

text_es: When starting to learn a new language, it's great to dive in completely, but while maintaining realistic expectations. One of the most common mistakes is wanting to master everything immediately, instead of accepting gradual progress; it's crucial to celebrate every small victory while exposing yourself to authentic material. When listening and reading, avoid translating every word; instead, try to understand the general context, a very effective tactic. Amidst the frustration that will inevitably arise, remember your initial goal and maintain daily discipline; dedicate at least 30 minutes a day and look for opportunities to practice with native speakers. From the many activities available, select two or three that work effectively for you and don't overwhelm yourself with too many methods, ensuring the process is fun.
text_tgt_raw: Ao iniciar a aprendizagem de uma nova língua, é ótimo mergulhar completamente, mas mantendo expectativas realistas. Um dos erros mais comuns é querer dominar tudo de imediato, em vez de aceitar o progresso gradual; é crucial celebrar cada pequena vitória enquanto se expõe a material autêntico. Ao ouvir e ler, evite traduzir cada palavra; procure antes entender o contexto geral, uma tática muito eficaz. No meio da frustração que inevitavelmente surgirá, lembre-se do seu objetivo inicial e mantenha a disciplina diária; dedique pelo menos 30 minutos por dia e procure oportunidades para praticar com falantes nativos. Das muitas atividades disponíveis, selecione duas ou três que funcionem efetivamente para si e não se sobrecarregue com demasiados métodos, garantindo que o processo seja divertido.
base_en: When beginning to learn a new language, it's crucial to immerse yourself completely, while maintaining realistic expectations. Among the most common mistakes is wanting to master everything at 1st, instead of accepting gradual progress; it's important to celebrate every small advance while exposing yourself to authentic material. While listening and reading, try not to translate every word, but rather to understand the general context, a very effective method. Amid the frustration that will inevitably arise, remember why you started and maintain daily discipline; dedicate at least 30 minutes a day, while looking for opportunities to practice with native speakers. Among the available resources, choose 2 or 3 that really work for you and don't overwhelm yourself with too many methods, while having fun with the process.

text_es: Participating in a popular race is a great activity that involves the community in a spirit of overcoming challenges. This type of sporting event, open to the general public, brings together runners of all ages and fitness levels, promoting coexistence and self-improvement. The distances vary, from 5 km to half marathons, offering everyone the opportunity to test their physical endurance while enjoying a festive atmosphere. It's common to see the streets full of people cheering, generating a contagious energy that drives participants to achieve their goals. Preparation for these races requires gradual and consistent training, with attention to diet and rest, being, in fact, a process that extends over several months. The reward, upon crossing the finish line, is a moment of great satisfaction and the achievement of a goal, often the direction for the next race.
text_tgt_raw: A participação numa corrida popular é uma ótima atividade que envolve a comunidade num espírito de superação. Este tipo de espetáculo desportivo, aberto ao público em geral, reúne corredores de todas as idades e níveis de aptidão, promovendo a coexistência e a auto-superação. As distâncias são variadas, desde 5 km a meias maratonas, oferecendo a todos a oportunidade de testar a sua resistência física enquanto desfrutam de um ambiente festivo. É comum ver as ruas cheias de pessoas a apoiar, gerando uma energia contagiante que impulsiona os participantes a alcançar os seus objetivos. A preparação para estas corridas exige um treino gradual e constante, com atenção à dieta e ao descanso, sendo, de facto, um processo que se estende por vários meses. A recompensa, ao cruzar a linha da meta, é um momento de grande satisfação e a concretização de um objetivo, muitas vezes a direção para a próxima prova.
base_en: Running a popular race involves participating in a sporting event open to the general public, where runners of various ages and skill levels compete together, while fostering coexistence and a spirit of self-improvement. These races, which often include distances of 5 km, 10 km, or even half marathons, are an excellent opportunity to test physical endurance, while enjoying the festive atmosphere. It's common to see people cheering in the streets, creating an atmosphere of contagious energy, while participants strive to achieve their goals. Preparation for a popular race usually requires gradual and constant training, while taking care of diet and rest, between 2 and 3 months before the event. Finally, the moment of crossing the finish line is a reward in itself, amid the applause of the public and the satisfaction of having completed the challenge, while many are already thinking about the next race.

text_es: This Sunday, I decided to participate in my first community race in the neighborhood, an experience I had long wanted to have. I woke up early, even before the sun fully rose, with that mix of nervousness and excitement. At the starting line, the atmosphere was great: there were more than 500 people, including experienced athletes and novices like me, all with a smile. While we waited for the starting signal, I chatted a bit with the person next to me, who gave me some encouragement. The first two kilometers were challenging, but the energy of the people, the shouts of encouragement from the crowd, propelled me forward. I ran at my own pace, enjoying the scenery as I passed through familiar streets, and the feeling of crossing the finish line, amidst the applause, was unbeatable. Without a doubt, I will repeat it soon, as long as my legs allow it, as this physical activity is an excellent way to keep the body active. The race organization was exemplary, and the project to encourage local sports is worthy of applause.
text_tgt_raw: Este domingo, decidi participar na minha primeira corrida popular no bairro, uma experiência que há muito desejava viver. Levantei-me cedo, ainda antes do sol nascer por completo, com aquela mistura de nervosismo e entusiasmo. Na linha de partida, a atmosfera era ótima: havia mais de 500 pessoas, entre atletas experientes e novatos como eu, todos com um sorriso. Enquanto esperávamos pelo sinal de partida, conversei um pouco com a pessoa ao meu lado, que me deu algum encorajamento. Os primeiros dois quilómetros foram desafiantes, mas a energia das pessoas, os gritos de incentivo da multidão, impulsionaram-me. Corri ao meu ritmo, apreciando a paisagem enquanto passava por ruas familiares, e a sensação de cruzar a meta, no meio dos aplausos, foi imbatível. Sem dúvida, vou repetir em breve, enquanto as minhas pernas o permitirem, pois esta atividade física é uma excelente forma de manter o corpo ativo. A direção da prova foi exemplar, e o projeto de incentivo ao desporto local é digno de aplauso.
base_en: This Sunday I decided to run my 1st popular race in the neighborhood, an experience I'd been wanting to try for a while. I woke up early, while the sun wasn't fully out yet, with that mix of nerves and excitement. At the starting line, the atmosphere was incredible: there were more than 500 people, among experienced athletes and novices like me, all with a smile. While we waited for the starting gun, I chatted a bit with the person next to me, who gave me some encouragement. The 1st 2 km were tough, but the energy of the people, the shouts of encouragement amid the crowd, pushed me forward. I ran at my own pace, enjoying the scenery as I passed through familiar streets, and the feeling of crossing the finish line, amid all the applause, was unbeatable. Without a doubt, I'll repeat soon, while my legs allow me to.

text_es: For your first popular race, the main goal should be to enjoy the experience, maintaining a steady and comfortable pace. It's great not to try to go too fast at the beginning, among the other runners, as you will quickly burn out; it's preferable to start slow while your body adapts. Make sure you've rested well and eaten something light 2 or 3 hours before, hydrating adequately. During the race, pay attention to your body and, if you feel any discomfort in the crowd, slow down or stop for a moment. Think that the goal is to finish, not to win, and upon crossing the finish line, you will feel enormous satisfaction. Enjoy the atmosphere, the collective energy, and the mutual support among all participants. This activity should be an act of pure pleasure.
text_tgt_raw: Para a sua primeira corrida popular, o objetivo principal deve ser desfrutar da experiência, mantendo um ritmo constante e confortável. É ótimo não tentar ir demasiado rápido no início, entre os outros corredores, pois irá esgotar-se rapidamente; é preferível começar devagar enquanto o seu corpo se adapta. Assegure-se de que descansou bem e comeu algo leve 2 ou 3 horas antes, hidratando-se adequadamente. Durante a corrida, preste atenção ao seu corpo e, se sentir algum mal-estar na multidão, abrande ou pare por um momento. Pense que a meta é terminar, não vencer, e ao cruzar a linha de chegada, sentirá uma satisfação enorme. Aproveite a atmosfera, a energia coletiva e a proteção mútua entre todos os participantes. Esta atividade deve ser um ato de puro prazer.
base_en: For your 1st popular race, focus on enjoying the experience, while maintaining a constant and comfortable pace. Don't try to go too fast at the beginning, among the other runners, as you'll get exhausted quickly; it's preferable to start slowly while your body adapts. Make sure you've rested well and eaten something light 2 or 3 hours before, while hydrating adequately. During the race, listen to your body and, if you feel bad amid the crowd, slow down or stop for a moment. Think that the goal is to finish it, not to win, and while you cross the finish line, you'll feel great satisfaction. Enjoy the atmosphere, among the rest of the participants, and the shared energy amid all the runners.

text_es: The restoration of antique furniture is a deeply rewarding activity that aims to revive the beauty and functionality of pieces with history, protecting their cultural value. Generally, this action involves several stages, starting with a thorough inspection to detect structural and aesthetic damage. The process includes deep cleaning and the removal of old layers of varnish or paint, and it is crucial to maintain the object's originality. Damaged parts, such as broken legs or loose veneers, are repaired with techniques and materials that respect the furniture's era, avoiding solutions that drastically alter its appearance. The choice of the final finish is a determining factor, with options ranging from oils and waxes to varnishes, seeking to replicate the original appearance or give the piece new life, always with an excellent result. It is a job that requires patience, attention, and in-depth knowledge of furniture history and style, ensuring that every act of restoration contributes to its preservation.
text_tgt_raw: A restauração de mobiliário antigo é uma atividade profundamente gratificante, que visa reviver a beleza e funcionalidade de peças com história, protegendo o seu valor cultural. Geralmente, esta ação implica diversas etapas, começando com uma inspeção minuciosa para detetar danos estruturais e estéticos. O processo inclui a limpeza profunda e a remoção de camadas antigas de verniz ou tinta, sendo crucial manter a originalidade do objeto. Peças danificadas, como pernas partidas ou folheados soltos, são reparadas com técnicas e materiais que respeitam a época do móvel, evitando soluções que alterem drasticamente o seu aspeto. A escolha do acabamento final é um fator determinante, com opções que vão desde óleos e ceras a vernizes, procurando replicar o aspeto original ou dar uma nova vida à peça, sempre com um ótimo resultado. É um trabalho que exige paciência, atenção e um conhecimento aprofundado da história e estilo do mobiliário, garantindo que cada ato de restauro contribui para a sua preservação.
base_en: Restoring antique furniture is a rewarding process that revives the beauty and functionality of pieces with history, while preserving their cultural value. Generally, it involves several stages, among them deep cleaning and the removal of old layers of varnish or paint, while the structural integrity of the piece is evaluated. Amid this work, damaged parts, such as broken legs or detached veneers, are repaired using traditional techniques and materials compatible with the furniture's original era, while drastic solutions are avoided. The choice of the final finish is crucial, among options like oils, waxes, or varnishes, while seeking to replicate the original look or give the furniture new life. It's an art that requires patience and skill, while considering the furniture's history and style. Amid the challenges that may arise, the final result is a restored piece that can last many more years, while decorating and telling its own story.

text_es: The decision to restore a piece of antique furniture came to me suddenly, while I was browsing an antique market. I saw an Elizabethan chest of drawers, discolored and with several layers of paint that hid its original beauty; among all the objects, this piece caught my eye. I started the project with some apprehension, carefully sanding each corner and discovering the wood grain that had been hidden for decades. It was a slow process, amidst wood shavings and the smell of varnish, that required a lot of patience as it progressed day after day. I learned about different carpentry and finishing techniques, from specialized books and online tutorials, while listening to classical music to relax. Seeing the furniture regain its original splendor was great; amidst all the effort, the reward was immense, as I imagined its new life in my living room. The direction of the work was entirely mine, making the result even more gratifying. This act of renovation, which culminated in its protection, was a truly rewarding activity, demonstrating that, even in current times, craftsmanship has invaluable worth.
text_tgt_raw: A decisão de restaurar uma peça de mobiliário antigo surgiu de repente, enquanto eu passeava por um mercado de antiguidades. Vi uma cómoda isabelina, descolorada e com várias camadas de tinta que escondiam a sua beleza original; entre todos os objetos, esta peça chamou-me a atenção. Iniciei o projeto com alguma apreensão, lixando cuidadosamente cada canto e descobrindo o grão da madeira que estivera oculto durante décadas. Foi um processo lento, entre aparas de madeira e o cheiro a verniz, que exigiu muita paciência à medida que avançava dia após dia. Aprendi sobre diferentes técnicas de carpintaria e acabamento, entre livros especializados e tutoriais online, enquanto ouvia música clássica para relaxar. Ver o móvel readquirir o seu esplendor original foi ótimo; entre todo o esforço, a recompensa foi imensa, enquanto eu imaginava a sua nova vida na minha sala. A direção dos trabalhos foi inteiramente minha, tornando o resultado ainda mais gratificante. Este ato de renovação, que culminou na sua proteção, foi uma atividade verdadeiramente compensadora, demonstrando que, mesmo em tempos atuais, o artesanato tem um valor inestimável.
base_en: The decision to restore an antique piece of furniture came suddenly, while I was strolling through an antique market. I saw an Elizabethan chest of drawers, discolored, and with several layers of paint that hid its original beauty; among all the objects, this piece caught my attention. I started the project with some trepidation, while carefully sanding every corner, discovering the wood grain that had been hidden for decades. It was a slow process, amid wood shavings and the smell of varnish, that required a lot of patience as I progressed day by day. I learned about different carpentry and finishing techniques, among specialized books and online tutorials, while listening to classical music to relax. Seeing the furniture regain its original splendor was incredible; amid all the effort, the reward was immense, while I imagined its new life in my living room.

text_es: When restoring an antique piece of furniture, patience is a crucial factor at every step of the process. Start with a deep cleaning to remove dirt and dust accumulated over the years. Identify any damage and decide on your direction, considering whether you want to maintain the original patina or adopt a more modern finish, among the various options. Sand carefully, gradually progressing from a coarser to a finer grit, and prepare the surface for the next step, which could be staining or painting. Apply thin and even layers of finish, waiting for the optimal drying time between each one. Enjoy the activity of watching the beauty of the antique furniture resurface in your hands, an act of dedication that culminates in a renewed object.
text_tgt_raw: Ao restaurar um móvel antigo, a paciência é um fator crucial em cada etapa do processo. Comece com uma limpeza profunda, para remover a sujidade e o pó acumulados ao longo dos anos. Detete os danos e defina a sua direção, ponderando se pretende manter a pátina original ou adotar um acabamento mais atual, entre as várias opções. Lixe cuidadosamente, progredindo gradualmente de uma granulação mais grossa para uma mais fina, e prepare a superfície para o passo seguinte, que pode ser tingir ou pintar. Aplique camadas finas e uniformes de acabamento, aguardando o tempo de secagem ótimo entre cada uma. Desfrute da atividade de ver a beleza do móvel antigo ressurgir nas suas mãos, um ato de dedicação que culmina num objeto renovado.
base_en: When restoring an antique piece of furniture, patience is key while you work through each stage of the process. Start with a deep cleaning, while you remove accumulated dust and dirt from over the years. Identify the damage and define your approach, while you consider whether you want to maintain the original patina or if you prefer a more modern finish among the options. Sand carefully, while you gradually progress from a coarser grit to a finer one, and prepare the surface for the next step, which could be staining or painting. Apply thin, even coats of finish, while you wait the appropriate drying time between each one. Enjoy the process of watching the beauty of the antique furniture resurface in your hands.

text_es: Organizing a birthday party requires careful planning, coordinating the various elements for an optimal result. It is essential to define the number of guests – among family and friends – and the available budget, adopting a theme if desired. The selection of the venue is a crucial factor, whether at home or in a rented space, and it is important to send out invitations in advance so that everyone can organize themselves, while food and drinks are chosen. Activities or games should be considered to entertain those present, especially the little ones, during the celebration. We cannot forget the cake, which is the central object of the party, nor the decoration, which should be set up to create a festive atmosphere. It is an activity that requires attention, but, in the end, the most important thing is to enjoy the process and the company.
text_tgt_raw: Organizar uma festa de aniversário exige uma cuidadosa planificação, coordenando os vários elementos para um resultado ótimo. É fundamental definir o número de convidados – entre família e amigos – e o orçamento disponível, adotando um tema se desejado. A seleção do local é um fator crucial, quer seja em casa ou num espaço alugado, e é importante enviar os convites com antecedência para que todos possam organizar-se, enquanto a comida e as bebidas são escolhidas. Devem ser consideradas atividades ou jogos para entreter os presentes, especialmente os mais pequenos, durante a celebração. Não podemos esquecer o bolo, que é o objeto central da festa, nem a decoração, que deve ser montada para criar uma atmosfera festiva. É uma atividade que requer atenção, mas, no fim, o mais importante é desfrutar do processo e da companhia.
base_en: Organizing a birthday party requires careful planning while coordinating various elements. It's essential to define the number of guests—among family and friends—and the available budget, while choosing a theme if desired. The selection of the venue is crucial, whether at home or renting a space, and it's important to send it in advance so that guests can organize themselves while the food and drinks are chosen. Activities or games should be considered to entertain attendees, especially the little ones, amid the celebration. Don't forget the cake, the central element of the party, while organizing the decoration to create a festive atmosphere. Finally, amid all the preparations, the most important thing is to enjoy the process and the company.

text_es: Organizing my 40th birthday was a true odyssey, as it mixed excitement with the chaos it entailed. I started this activity two months in advance, drawing up guest lists and thinking about the theme. During the preparation, I realized that my house wouldn't be big enough, which led me to look for an alternative venue, while costs increased considerably. My direction was for a menu with vegetarian and gluten-free options, in an attempt to please each of the 50 guests. On the afternoon of the party, between the decorations and the arrival of the first guests, I felt a little overwhelmed, but the music was already playing and laughter began to fill the air. In the end, as I danced and celebrated with my loved ones, all the tension dissipated, and I felt it was a great and unforgettable celebration. The result was a moment of pure happiness, despite the initial challenging aspects, and an act of love for myself and my loved ones.
text_tgt_raw: Organizar o meu 40.º aniversário foi uma verdadeira odisseia, uma vez que misturou a excitação com o caos que isso implicou. Iniciei esta atividade com dois meses de antecedência, elaborando listas de convidados e pensando no tema. Durante a preparação, detetei que o espaço da minha casa não seria suficiente, o que me levou a procurar um local alternativo, enquanto os custos aumentavam de forma considerável. A minha direção foi para um menu com opções vegetarianas e sem glúten, numa tentativa de agradar a cada um dos 50 convidados. Na tarde da festa, entre as decorações e a chegada dos primeiros convidados, senti-me um pouco sobrecarregada, mas a música já tocava e as gargalhadas começavam a encher o ambiente. No final, enquanto dançava e celebrava com os meus entes queridos, toda a tensão se dissipou, e senti que foi uma ótima e inesquecível celebração. O resultado foi um momento de felicidade pura, apesar dos aspetos desafiadores iniciais, e um ato de amor por mim e pelos meus.
base_en: Organizing my 40th birthday was a real odyssey, between the excitement and the chaos it entailed. I started planning it 2 months in advance, while making guest lists and thinking about the theme. Amid the preparation, I realized that the space in my house wasn't enough, so I had to look for a venue, while expenses soared. I chose a menu that everyone would like, among vegetarian and gluten-free options, while trying to please each of my 50 guests. On the afternoon of the party, amid the decorations and the arrival of the 1st attendees, I felt overwhelmed, while the music was already playing and laughter began to fill the air. In the end, while dancing and celebrating with my loved ones, all the tension dissipated and I felt truly happy, despite the initial challenges.

text_es: Organizing a successful birthday party requires careful action and detailed planning. Start by creating a guest list to get an exact idea of the number of attendees and, at the same time, set a realistic budget to avoid overspending. It's great to decide on the date and venue well in advance, perhaps 2 to 3 months for a larger event, and look for inspiration for the theme and decorations. Think about food and drinks, considering possible allergies or dietary preferences, and delegate some activities to trusted friends or family so you don't feel overwhelmed. Don't forget the music and entertainment, ensuring everything is under control so you can also enjoy the celebration. This is an important goal: that you have fun!
text_tgt_raw: Organizar uma festa de aniversário de sucesso exige uma ação cuidadosa e um planeamento detalhado. Comece por criar uma lista de convidados para ter uma ideia exata do número de participantes e, simultaneamente, defina um orçamento realista para evitar gastos excessivos. É ótimo decidir a data e o local com bastante antecedência, talvez 2 a 3 meses para um evento de maior dimensão, e procurar inspiração para o tema e as decorações. Pense na comida e nas bebidas, considerando possíveis alergias ou preferências alimentares, e delegue algumas atividades a amigos ou familiares de confiança para não se sentir sobrecarregado. Não se esqueça da música e do entretenimento, assegurando que tudo está sob controle para que também possa desfrutar da celebração. Este é um objetivo importante: que se divirta!
base_en: Organizing a successful birthday party requires planning. Start with the guest list to know how many people will attend, while defining a realistic budget so you don't overspend. Decide on the date and venue with enough anticipation—2 to 3 months if it's a large event—while looking for inspiration for the theme and decorations. Think about food and drinks, considering possible allergies or dietary preferences among your guests, and delegate tasks to trusted friends or family members so you don't get overwhelmed. Don't forget the music and entertainment, while making sure everything is under control so you can also enjoy yourself amid the celebration. And most importantly: have fun.

text_es: Caring for indoor plants requires special attention to several factors to ensure their health and optimal growth, integrating them harmoniously into our home. It is essential to carefully select species suitable for the indoor environment, considering available light, temperature, and humidity. Currently, correct lighting is a critical factor; many plants thrive near windows, while others prefer a spot with indirect light. Watering should be adapted to each plant, as some need constantly moist soil, while others prefer it to dry slightly between waterings. In addition to this activity, it is also important to fertilize periodically and wipe dust off the leaves to facilitate photosynthesis, while monitoring for the appearance of pests. Among the most common mistakes are overwatering and lack of adequate drainage, which can cause diseases and, ultimately, the death of the plant.
text_tgt_raw: Cuidar de plantas de interior exige uma atenção especial a vários fatores para assegurar a sua saúde e um crescimento ótimo, integrando-as de forma harmoniosa no nosso lar. É essencial fazer uma seleção cuidadosa de espécies adequadas ao ambiente interior, considerando a luz disponível, a temperatura e a humidade. Atualmente, a iluminação correta é um fator crítico; muitas plantas prosperam perto de janelas, enquanto outras preferem um cantinho com luz indireta. A rega deve ser adaptada a cada planta, pois algumas precisam de solo constantemente húmido, ao passo que outras preferem que seque ligeiramente entre regas. Além desta atividade, é também importante fertilizar periodicamente e limpar o pó das folhas para facilitar a fotossíntese, monitorizando o aparecimento de pragas. Entre os erros mais comuns estão o excesso de rega e a falta de drenagem adequada, que podem provocar doenças e, em última instância, a morte da planta.
base_en: Caring for indoor plants requires attention to several key factors to ensure their health and optimal growth, while integrating them harmoniously into our home. It's essential to choose suitable species for the indoor environment, considering available light, temperature, and humidity, while avoiding over or under watering. Good lighting is crucial; many plants thrive near windows, while others prefer corners with indirect light. Watering must be adapted to each plant, as some need constantly moist soil, while others prefer it to dry slightly between waterings. Amid this care, it's also important to fertilize periodically and clean dust from the leaves to facilitate photosynthesis, while monitoring for the appearance of pests. Among common mistakes are overwatering and lack of adequate drainage, which can cause diseases and the death of the plant.

text_es: Caring for my houseplants has become a personal therapy, a way to find calm while the outside world maintains its frantic pace. Every morning, while I prepare coffee, I dedicate a few minutes to observing them, seeing how the morning sun—between the clouds—illuminates their leaves, an aspect that delights me. I remember the first time one of my orchids bloomed; it was a great joy, a true exception, and it made me realize how rewarding this hobby is, even with daily activity and stress. I maintain a strict watering schedule, especially for the most delicate ones, and I always try to detect the nutrients they need. Sometimes, in the middle of a work meeting or a demanding project, I find myself thinking about my ficuses or my pothos, eager to get home to see how they are. It's a constant act of remembering life and growth, while my home fills with fresher, purer air. Among my friends, they already know me as the "plant lady," and I couldn't be prouder of this adoption of a new title.
text_tgt_raw: Cuidar das minhas plantas de interior tornou-se uma terapia pessoal, uma forma de encontrar calma enquanto o mundo exterior mantém o seu ritmo frenético. Todas as manhãs, enquanto preparo o café, dedico alguns minutos a observá-las, vendo como o sol da manhã — entre as nuvens — ilumina as suas folhas, um aspeto que me encanta. Lembro-me da primeira vez que uma das minhas orquídeas floresceu; foi uma alegria ótima, uma verdadeira exceção, e fez-me perceber quão gratificante é este passatempo, mesmo com a atividade diária e o stress. Mantenho um horário de rega rigoroso, especialmente para as mais delicadas, e procuro sempre detetar os nutrientes de que necessitam. Por vezes, no meio de uma reunião de trabalho ou de um projeto exigente, dou por mim a pensar nos meus ficus ou nos meus potos, ansioso por chegar a casa para ver como estão. É uma ação constante de lembrança da vida e do crescimento, enquanto a minha casa se enche de ar mais fresco e puro. Entre os meus amigos, já me conhecem como a "senhora das plantas", e não poderia estar mais orgulhosa desta adoção de um novo título.
base_en: Caring for my indoor plants has become a personal therapy, a way to find calm while the outside world continues its frantic pace. Every morning, while I prepare coffee, I dedicate a few minutes to observing them, seeing how the attic sun—between the clouds—illuminates their leaves. I remember the 1st time one of my orchids bloomed; it was an immense joy, comparable to few things, and it made me realize how rewarding this hobby is, among the daily stress. I maintain a strict watering schedule, especially for the most delicate ones, while I try to figure out what nutrients they need. Sometimes, in the middle of a work meeting or a demanding project, I find myself thinking about my ficuses or my pothos, wanting to get home to see how they're. It's a constant reminder of life and growth, while my home fills with fresher, purer air. Among my friends, they already know me as the "plant lady," and I couldn't be prouder of it.

text_es: When starting out with indoor plant care, it's essential to select species suitable for your home, considering the natural light available. Look for resilient plants, among the many existing varieties, that don't require excessive attention while you learn the basics. Ensure the soil is correct for each type of plant and that you water them appropriately, avoiding overwatering which can rot the roots; observe the soil between waterings. Fertilize sparingly, following product instructions, to avoid burning delicate roots. Place plants in locations where they receive sufficient light, but avoid direct sun exposure during the hottest hours of the day. Maintain adequate ambient humidity, considering the specific needs of each plant. Regularly inspect your plants for pests or diseases, acting quickly to control them, which is an excellent preventive measure.
text_tgt_raw: Ao iniciar-se no cuidado de plantas de interior, é essencial selecionar espécies adequadas para o seu lar, tendo em conta a luz natural disponível. Procure plantas resilientes, entre as muitas variedades existentes, que não exijam atenção excessiva enquanto aprende o básico. Assegure-se de que o substrato é o correto para cada tipo de planta e que as rega adequadamente, evitando o excesso de água que pode apodrecer as raízes; observe o solo entre regas. Fertilize com moderação, seguindo as instruções do produto, para não queimar raízes delicadas. Coloque as plantas em locais onde recebam luz suficiente, mas evite a exposição direta ao sol durante as horas mais quentes do dia. Mantenha uma humidade ambiente adequada, considerando as necessidades específicas de cada planta. Inspecione regularmente as suas plantas em busca de pragas ou doenças, agindo rapidamente para as controlar, o que constitui uma ação preventiva ótima.
base_en: When starting out with indoor plant care, it's essential to choose suitable species for your home, while considering the natural light available. Look for resilient plants, among the many existing varieties, that don't require excessive attention, while you learn the basics. Make sure the substrate is correct for each type of plant and that you water them properly, avoiding excess water that can rot the roots; observe the soil between waterings. Fertilize in moderation, while following product instructions, so as not to burn delicate roots. Place plants in locations where they receive sufficient light, but avoid direct sun exposure during the hottest hours of the day. Maintain adequate ambient humidity, while considering the specific needs of each plant. Regularly inspect your plants for pests or diseases, while acting quickly to control them.

text_es: Choosing the right mattress is extremely important to ensure restorative sleep and good postural health, preventing back problems. It is essential to consider the type of firmness, which should adapt to each person's weight and sleeping position; when testing a mattress, lying down for at least 10 minutes is crucial. Among the most popular materials currently, latex, memory foam, and springs stand out, each with its own characteristics of adaptability and breathability. Furthermore, our comfort is also influenced by the size of the mattress, especially if shared, to ensure enough space and avoid nighttime interruptions. One should not rush when faced with so many options; comparing models and reading other users' reviews can be a decisive factor. It's a great idea to visit specialized stores, where personalized service can help identify the best option. Finally, budget is an aspect to consider, but investing in a good mattress is, effectively, a long-term investment in our health.
text_tgt_raw: A escolha do colchão correto é de extrema importância para garantir um sono reparador e uma boa saúde postural, evitando problemas nas costas. É fundamental considerar o tipo de firmeza, que deve adaptar-se ao peso e à posição de dormir de cada um; ao testar um colchão, a ação de deitar-se por, pelo menos, 10 minutos é crucial. Entre os materiais mais populares atualmente, destacam-se o látex, a espuma viscoelástica e as molas, cada um com as suas características de adaptabilidade e respirabilidade. Além disso, a direção do nosso conforto passa também pelo tamanho do colchão, especialmente se partilhado, para assegurar espaço suficiente e evitar interrupções noturnas. Não se deve apressar perante tantas opções; comparar modelos e ler as opiniões de outros utilizadores pode ser um fator decisivo. É ótima ideia visitar lojas especializadas, onde o atendimento personalizado pode ajudar a detetar a melhor opção. Por fim, o orçamento é um aspeto a ponderar, mas investir num bom colchão é, efetivamente, um investimento a longo prazo na nossa saúde.
base_en: Choosing the right mattress is crucial for ensuring restful sleep and good postural health, while a poor choice can lead to back problems. It's essential to consider the type of firmness, as it must adapt to each person's weight and sleeping position; while trying out a mattress, it's important to lie on it for at least 10 minutes. Among the most common materials are latex, memory foam, and springs, each with its own characteristics of adaptability and breathability. Furthermore, it's essential to think about the size of the mattress, especially if it's shared, to ensure enough space for both, while avoiding interruptions during the night. Don't rush amid so many options; comparing models and reading reviews from other users can be very helpful. It's advisable to go to specialized stores where staff can offer personalized advice, while evaluating the different sensations. Finally, budget is another factor to consider, although investing in a good mattress is a long-term investment in health.

text_es: Selecting the mattress for our double bed was a true odyssey that lasted almost two weeks. My partner and I wanted something that would please both of us, seeking the optimal balance between firmness and adaptability. I remember that, in the middle of the showroom, we tried at least fifteen different models, under the patient gaze of the saleswoman, who showed an exemplary attitude. We lay down, moved around, and debated, between laughs and arguments, the positive aspects of each one. Finally, after much deliberation and when fatigue was truly setting in, we made the decision to adopt a memory foam model, which promised restful sleep. Nowadays, every night, as we sink into its soft surface, we fondly recall that fun search among the countless options, an action we now see as a successful project.
text_tgt_raw: A seleção do colchão para a cama de casal foi uma verdadeira odisseia que se estendeu por quase duas semanas. O meu companheiro e eu desejávamos algo que agradasse a ambos, procurando o equilíbrio ótimo entre firmeza e adaptabilidade. Lembro-me de que, no meio do salão de exposição, experimentámos pelo menos quinze modelos diferentes, sob o olhar paciente da vendedora, que mostrou uma atitude exemplar. Deitámo-nos, movimentámo-nos e debatemos, entre risos e argumentos, os aspetos positivos de cada um. Finalmente, após muita deliberação e quando o cansaço já se fazia sentir de forma efetiva, tomámos a decisão de adotar um modelo de espuma de memória, que prometia um sono reparador. Atualmente, todas as noites, ao afundarmo-nos na sua superfície macia, recordamos com carinho aquela divertida busca entre as inúmeras opções, uma ação que hoje vemos como um projeto bem-sucedido.
base_en: Choosing a mattress for the double bed was an odyssey that lasted almost 2 weeks. My partner and I wanted something that we both liked, while we searched for the perfect balance between firmness and adaptability. I remember that, in the middle of the showroom, we tried at least 15 different models, while the saleswoman watched us with admirable patience. We lay down, we moved around, and we debated with laughter and arguments about the benefits of each one. Finally, after much deliberation and while fatigue was starting to take its toll, we decided on a memory foam one that promised a restful sleep. Now, every night, while we sink into its soft surface, we fondly remember that fun search, among all the possible options.

text_es: When choosing a mattress, it's essential to consider several factors to ensure optimal rest and prevent future back problems. There are various options on the market, with different materials and technologies, making careful selection important. Currently, the offerings are vast, including springs, latex, and memory foam, and each type has unique aspects that may better suit your sleeping posture. Don't limit yourself to just the price; the quality of the materials is a determining factor for durability and comfort, and reading reviews from other users can be very helpful. This is a decision that represents a long-term investment, so it should not be made hastily. You need to keep the main objective in mind: adequate support for your spine and a level of firmness that, combined with comfort, promotes a restorative night's sleep. Many stores offer a trial period, a great opportunity for your body to adapt and to ensure you made the correct choice.
text_tgt_raw: Ao escolher um colchão, é essencial considerar vários fatores para garantir um ótimo descanso e evitar problemas de coluna no futuro. Existem diversas opções no mercado, com diferentes materiais e tecnologias, sendo importante uma seleção cuidada. Atualmente, a oferta é vasta, incluindo molas, látex e espuma viscoelástica, e cada tipo possui aspetos únicos que podem adequar-se melhor à sua postura de sono. Não se limite apenas ao preço; a qualidade dos materiais é um fator determinante para a durabilidade e o conforto, e a leitura de avaliações de outros utilizadores pode ser de grande ajuda. Esta é uma decisão que representa um investimento a longo prazo, por isso, não deve ser tomada de forma precipitada. É preciso ter em mente o objetivo principal: um apoio adequado para a coluna e um nível de firmeza que, em conjunto com o conforto, promova uma noite de sono reparadora. Muitas lojas oferecem um período experimental, uma ótima oportunidade para o seu corpo se adaptar e para garantir que fez a escolha correta.
base_en: When choosing a mattress, it's essential to consider several factors to ensure good rest, while avoiding back problems in the future. Try different types, among those with springs, latex, and memory foam, while making sure it adapts to your sleeping posture. It's crucial not only to look at the price, but also at the quality of the materials, while seeking opinions from other users. Don't rush the decision, as it's a long-term investment; among the many options available, take time to research and compare. Make sure that, amid so much on offer, the mattress provides adequate support for your spine and is firm enough, while also being comfortable. Many stores offer a trial period; take advantage of it, while you get used to the new mattress.

text_es: Reducing food waste is a crucial action for sustainability, simultaneously addressing resource scarcity and global food security. It is estimated that, annually, one-third of all food produced is lost or wasted, from production to final consumption. This happens while millions of people suffer from hunger, a striking paradox today. Implementing practices such as meal planning, proper storage, and using leftovers can generate an optimal impact, contributing to a healthier planet. It is vital to educate the population about these practices, both in homes and businesses, to foster effective change. Furthermore, government policies and technological innovation play a fundamental role in reducing waste on a large scale, as we seek more efficient solutions throughout the supply chain for this goal.
text_tgt_raw: A redução do desperdício alimentar é uma ação crucial para a sustentabilidade, abordando simultaneamente a escassez de recursos e a segurança alimentar global. Estima-se que, anualmente, um terço de todos os alimentos produzidos se perca ou seja desperdiçado, desde a produção até ao consumo final. Isto acontece enquanto milhões de pessoas sofrem de fome, um paradoxo marcante na atualidade. A implementação de práticas como o planeamento de refeições, o armazenamento correto e o aproveitamento de sobras pode gerar um impacto ótimo, contribuindo para um planeta mais saudável. É vital educar a população sobre estas práticas, tanto em lares como em negócios, para fomentar uma mudança efetiva. Além disso, políticas governamentais e inovação tecnológica desempenham um papel fundamental na redução do desperdício em larga escala, enquanto procuramos soluções mais eficientes em toda a cadeia de abastecimento para este objetivo.
base_en: Reducing food waste is a crucial action for sustainability, while we address resource scarcity and global food security. Each year, it's estimated that 1/3 of all food produced is lost or wasted, among production, distribution, and final consumption. This occurs while millions of people suffer from hunger, a striking paradox amid abundance. Implementing practices such as meal planning, proper storage, and using leftovers can make a big difference, while we contribute to a healthier planet. It's vital to educate the population about these practices, among households and businesses, to foster lasting change. Furthermore, government policies and technological innovation play a fundamental role in reducing large-scale waste, while we seek more efficient solutions throughout the supply chain, even amid economic challenges.

text_es: I've always been very aware of food waste; in my family, we called it "the shame." About two years ago, living alone, I realized how much fruit was spoiling in my fridge, amidst my daily distractions. It was frustrating to throw away food that, although fresh, could have been put to great use. I started planning meals for three days and buying only what was necessary, while on weekends I prepared portions to freeze. Between the leftovers and what I donated to a local animal shelter, I detected a 40% improvement in just one month. Currently, when cooking for more people, I ensure nothing goes to waste, always paying attention to expiration dates and quantities, amidst family activity. This action reflects a clear goal of optimizing resources and moving in a more sustainable direction.
text_tgt_raw: Sempre tive grande consciência do desperdício alimentar; na minha família, chamávamos-lhe "a vergonha". Há cerca de dois anos, a viver sozinha, apercebi-me da quantidade de fruta que se estragava no meu frigorífico, no meio da minha distração diária. Era frustrante deitar fora comida que, embora fresca, poderia ter tido um ótimo aproveitamento. Comecei a planear refeições para três dias e a comprar apenas o necessário, enquanto ao fim de semana preparava porções para congelar. Entre as sobras e o que doei a um abrigo de animais local, detetei uma melhoria de 40% em apenas um mês. Atualmente, ao cozinhar para mais pessoas, garanto que nada se desperdiça, sempre atenta às datas de validade e às quantidades, no meio da atividade familiar. Esta ação reflete um objetivo claro de otimizar os recursos e ter uma direção mais sustentável.

Between the leftovers and what I donated to a local animal shelter, I saw a 40% improvement in just 1 month. Now, while cooking for more people, I make sure nothing goes to waste, always attentive to expiration dates and quantities, amid the family whirlwind.

text_es: Learning to swim as an adult is an achievable goal for many, and a lack of prior experience is not an impediment. Many adults decide to learn to swim to improve their physical condition and gain other health benefits, or to feel safer in water activities with their families, while others seek to overcome an old fear. There are numerous courses designed specifically for adults, which offer a supportive environment and progressive learning, among peers who share similar goals. It is essential to find a qualified instructor who understands the particular aspects of teaching adults, and consistent practice is fundamental to gaining confidence. Among the benefits of learning to swim are muscle strengthening, cardiovascular improvement, and greater personal protection, and this process can generate a great renewal of love for the water.
text_tgt_raw: Aprender a nadar em idade adulta é um objetivo alcançável para muitos, e a falta de experiência prévia não constitui um impedimento. Muitos adultos decidem aprender a nadar para melhorar a sua condição física e ter outros benefícios de saúde, ou para se sentirem mais seguros em atividades aquáticas com as suas famílias, enquanto outros procuram superar um antigo medo. Existem inúmeros cursos projetados especificamente para adultos, que oferecem um ambiente de apoio e uma aprendizagem progressiva, entre pares que partilham objetivos semelhantes. É essencial encontrar um instrutor qualificado que compreenda os aspetos particulares do ensino a adultos, e a prática consistente é fundamental para adquirir confiança. Entre os benefícios de aprender a nadar estão o fortalecimento muscular, a melhoria cardiovascular e uma maior proteção pessoal, e este processo pode gerar uma ótima renovação do amor pela água.

There are numerous courses designed specifically for adults, which offer a supportive environment and progressive learning, among peers who share similar goals. It's essential to find a qualified instructor who understands the particularities of teaching adults, while consistent practice is key to acquiring confidence. Among the benefits of learning to swim are muscle strengthening, cardiovascular improvement, and greater personal safety, while amid the process a renewed love for water can develop.

text_es: At 30, I made the decision to learn to swim, an activity that eluded me while my friends had fun in the pool. I always felt a bit limited during summers, between barbecues and gatherings by the water, watching others enjoy themselves without a care. I signed up for lessons, somewhat embarrassed to be among small children, but with the clear goal of overcoming my fear. The first sessions were a challenge, trying to coordinate arms and legs, feeling the water as a hostile element. Little by little, and with the instructor's excellent patience, I started to feel more at ease. Nowadays, I can swim with relative ease, enjoying the feeling of freedom that I previously only observed in others. It was one of the best actions of my life, and now I'm enthusiastically preparing for the next beach vacation, with a completely new perspective.
text_tgt_raw: Aos 30 anos, tomei a decisão de aprender a nadar, uma atividade que me escapava enquanto os meus amigos se divertiam na piscina. Sempre me senti um pouco limitado nos verões, entre churrascos e reuniões junto à água, observando os outros desfrutarem sem preocupações. Inscrevi-me em aulas, algo envergonhado por estar entre crianças pequenas, mas com o objetivo claro de vencer o meu receio. As primeiras sessões foram um desafio, tentar coordenar braços e pernas, sentindo a água como um elemento hostil. Pouco a pouco, e com a paciência ótima do instrutor, comecei a sentir-me mais à vontade. Atualmente, consigo nadar com relativa facilidade, desfrutando da sensação de liberdade que antes apenas observava nos outros. Foi uma das melhores ações da minha vida, e agora preparo-me com entusiasmo para as próximas férias na praia, com uma perspetiva completamente nova.
base_en: When I was 30 years old, I decided it was time to learn to swim, a skill that eluded me while my friends splashed in the pool. I had always felt a bit limited in the summer, among the barbecues and gatherings by the water, while others enjoyed themselves without a care. I signed up for some classes, a little embarrassed among small children, but willing to overcome my fear. The 1st sessions were a challenge, while I tried to coordinate my arms and legs, feeling the water as a hostile element. Little by little, and while the instructor's patience didn't waver, I began to feel more comfortable. Now I can swim with a certain ease, enjoying the feeling of freedom that I previously only observed among others. It has been one of the best decisions of my life, while I prepare for my next beach vacation.

text_es: Learning to swim as an adult is a rewarding goal, and on this journey, patience is your best ally. Look for an instructor with excellent references who understands your fears and guides you step by step as you become familiar with the water. It is crucial to start in a shallow pool, if possible with other beginners, to feel more comfortable and secure. Practice breathing and floating repeatedly while your body adapts to a new environment. Don't get frustrated if progress is slow; many adults feel some apprehension in an unfamiliar environment. With persistence and the right support, you will find that, by following your instructor's direction, confidence grows and technique improves, allowing you to fully enjoy the water. The final result will be the conquest of a new activity, which will leave you with great self-affection.
text_tgt_raw: Aprender a nadar em idade adulta é um objetivo gratificante e, nesta jornada, a paciência é a sua melhor aliada. Procure um instrutor com ótimas referências que compreenda os seus receios e o guie passo a passo, enquanto se familiariza com a água. É um fator crucial começar numa piscina rasa, se possível com outros iniciantes, para se sentir mais confortável e seguro. Pratique a respiração e a flutuação repetidamente, enquanto o seu corpo se adapta a um novo ambiente. Não se frustre se o progresso for lento; muitos adultos sentem alguma apreensão num ambiente que não lhes é familiar. Com persistência e o apoio correto, verificará que, ao seguir a direção do seu instrutor, a confiança cresce e a técnica melhora, permitindo-lhe desfrutar plenamente da água. O resultado final será a conquista de uma nova atividade, que o deixará com um ótimo afeto por si próprio.

Don't get frustrated if progress is slow at 1st; many adults experience some apprehension amid an unfamiliar environment.
